title: DevOps Engineer
description:
**We're Hiring: DevOps Engineer – CI/CD & Cloud Infrastructure**

**Company: Kanishka Software Private Limited**

Position: DevOps Engineer – CI/CD & Cloud Infrastructure

Location: Ghatkopar East, Mumbai

Experience: 2 Years

Type: Full-Time, On-Site

**About Us**

Kanishka Software Private Limited is a technology solutions firm established by a team of professionals with extensive experience in business process consulting and software development.

**About the Role**

We are seeking a motivated and hands-on DevOps Engineer with 2 years of industry experience to support and enhance our cloud infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, deployment automation, monitoring, and production operations.

The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with AWS, Linux, Docker, CI/CD, infrastructure monitoring, alerting, and production troubleshooting, along with a strong willingness to learn and work in a fast-paced environment.

**Key Responsibilities**

**CI/CD & Automation**

* Design, implement, and maintain CI/CD pipelines for multiple projects
* Automate build, test, and deployment workflows to ensure reliable and fast releases
* Troubleshoot and resolve CI/CD pipeline failures and deployment issues
* Support automated deployments across development, UAT, and production environments
* Maintain deployment configurations and related documentation

**Cloud Infrastructure & Deployment**

* Provision, deploy, and manage AWS services including EC2, S3, RDS/DB instances, VPC, IAM, Load Balancers, and Auto Scaling Groups
* Implement environment-based infrastructure provisioning to ensure consistency across dev, UAT, and production
* Support scalable, highly available, and fault-tolerant cloud architectures
* Monitor AWS resource utilization and infrastructure health
* Assist in identifying underutilized or over-provisioned resources

**Monitoring, Alerting & Observability**

* Monitor AWS infrastructure, servers, databases, applications, and CI/CD pipelines
* Configure and maintain alerts for critical resources and services
* Monitor CPU, memory, disk utilization, network usage, database connections, storage capacity, service availability, and application errors
* Analyze infrastructure and application logs, metrics, and alerts to identify potential issues
* Proactively identify performance, capacity, and availability issues
* Maintain monitoring dashboards and health checks
* Respond to infrastructure and application alerts and coordinate with relevant teams for resolution

**Production Troubleshooting & Operations**

* Monitor and troubleshoot production, UAT, and infrastructure-related issues
* Troubleshoot issues related to AWS, Linux, applications, databases, networking, Docker, and deployments
* Analyze logs and system metrics to identify the root cause of issues
* Perform basic Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for recurring production incidents
* Support incident resolution, recovery, and rollback activities when required
* Verify system health and application availability after deployments
* Collaborate with development teams to resolve application and environment issues
* Ensure system reliability, performance, and uptime

**Containerization**

* Build, manage, and optimize Docker images and containers
* Deploy and manage containerized applications
* Troubleshoot Docker containers, logs, networking, volumes, and resource utilization
* Support microservices-based architectures

**Cloud-Native & Serverless**

* Work with cloud-native services and serverless platforms
* Assist in designing and maintaining event-driven and serverless workloads

**Security & Configuration**

* Follow AWS security best practices for infrastructure and deployments
* Manage basic IAM permissions, security groups, and access controls
* Ensure application credentials and sensitive configuration are securely managed
* Support SSL/TLS certificate management and renewals
* Assist in identifying and resolving infrastructure security and configuration issues

**Backup & Reliability**

* Monitor database and infrastructure backup status
* Assist with backup and restore activities
* Support high availability and disaster recovery requirements
* Participate in infrastructure recovery and business continuity activities when required

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* 2 years of hands-on industry experience as a DevOps Engineer
* Strong hands-on experience with AWS cloud infrastructure
* Good knowledge of EC2, S3, RDS/DB, VPC, IAM, Load Balancers, and Security Groups
* Hands-on experience with at least one CI/CD platform such as Jenkins, Bitbucket Pipelines, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or equivalent
* Good understanding of Git and version control
* Good knowledge of Linux system administration
* Ability to troubleshoot CPU, memory, disk, processes, services, permissions, networking, and system logs
* Hands-on experience with infrastructure and application monitoring
* Experience configuring and managing resource and service alerts
* Ability to analyze logs, metrics, and alerts for troubleshooting
* Hands-on experience with Docker
* Good understanding of basic networking concepts such as DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, TCP/IP, ports, and load balancing
* Basic proficiency in Python, Bash, and/or Node.js for automation and scripting
* Working knowledge of SQL and relational databases such as MySQL/PostgreSQL
* Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills
* Good communication and documentation skills

**Good to Have**

* Hands-on experience with Kubernetes
* Experience with Terraform or CloudFormation
* Experience with Prometheus and Grafana
* Experience with ELK, OpenSearch, or other centralized logging platforms
* Knowledge of AWS serverless services such as Lambda, SQS, SNS, EventBridge, or API Gateway
* Knowledge of AWS cost monitoring and optimization
* Experience with AWS WAF and cloud security tools
* Knowledge of NoSQL databases
* Understanding of advanced AWS networking and architecture
* Experience with vulnerability scanning and security monitoring

**What We Look For**

* Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills
* Willingness to learn and work with new technologies
* Ability to work independently as well as with development teams
* Proactive approach toward monitoring, reliability, and problem resolution
* Ability to work in a production environment and respond to infrastructure issues
* Good communication and documentation skills

title: Member of Technical Staff
description:
**About us**

Triton Infotech works with large, diverse datasets for AI development and enterprise use. We bring together structured and unstructured data from many sources and prepare it for secure storage, evaluation and delivery.

**The role**

A hands-on engineering role. You’ll own the pipeline that turns incoming data into an organised, verified, usable repository, working directly with terabyte- to petabyte-scale data, storage hardware, cloud platforms and AI-assisted workflows. You should be as comfortable debugging a failed transfer at the command line as managing a NAS or designing a repeatable ingestion and quality-check process.

**What you’ll do**

* **Data collection and ingestion:**
  coordinate receipt of datasets from multiple partners in India and abroad, via disks, NAS shares, secure links, cloud buckets and hosted repositories, and build reliable bulk upload, download and sync workflows.
* **Centralisation and organisation:**
  consolidate incoming data into Google Workspace and cloud object storage (GCS, S3, Azure Blob) with clear directory structures, naming conventions, metadata catalogues and source-level inventories.
* **NAS and storage systems:**
  configure, run and troubleshoot network-attached storage (SMB, NFS, rsync, SFTP/SSH), including RAID, permissions, snapshots, disk health, throughput, backup and recovery.
* **Cloud infrastructure:**
  work across GCP, AWS and Azure (compute, object storage, IAM, CLIs, lifecycle policies, transfer tools, logging and cost controls), and choose approaches based on volume, security, performance and budget.
* **Systems work:**
  use Linux, shell scripting and Python to automate file handling, large transfers and transformations, and diagnose filesystem, network, memory and disk I/O bottlenecks.
* **File-format fluency:**
  inspect, validate, convert and extract data across PDF, DOCX, TXT, CSV, JSON, XML, images, video, audio, archives, databases and engineering/CAD formats (DWG, DXF, STEP, STL, IFC).
* **Cleaning and QA:**
  find duplicates, corrupt or incomplete files, inconsistent metadata and missing records, using checksums, deduplication, schema validation, batch transformation and exception reports.
* **AI-enabled operations:**
  use Claude, ChatGPT and coding assistants to speed up scripting, classification, metadata extraction and QA, with proper review steps, and never share restricted data with external AI tools without authorisation.
* **Traceability and governance:**
  keep a record of every batch (when it arrived, where from, file count, size, format, changes made, access restrictions and delivery status), with least-privilege access, encryption and retention controls.
* **Operational ownership:**
  monitor ingestion jobs, maintain runbooks and dashboards, resolve transfer failures, coordinate with partners and the internal team, and deliver organised, verified datasets on time.

**What we’re looking for**

* Hands-on experience in data engineering, infrastructure, DevOps or systems administration, with large and varied datasets
* Strong Linux, Python and Bash skills
* Experience with at least one major cloud platform and with large file transfers (rclone, rsync, cloud CLIs)
* Familiarity with NAS, file-transfer protocols, permissions and backups
* Careful, well documented and security-minded; able to own work end to end
* B.Tech / B.E. in Computer Science or a related field

**Nice to have**

* Experience with multi-terabyte or petabyte-scale repositories, Docker, Git, SQL or OCR / document-processing pipelines

title: Technical Account Manager - OpenStack

* Understand your customers' technical infrastructures, hardware, processes, and offerings

title: SRE Engineer
description:
Role Overview
  
  
The selected SRE and DevOps professional will be responsible for maintaining highly available production systems, managing cloud infrastructure, improving observability, and supporting reliable deployment and operations practices. The role combines hands-on engineering with incident response, infrastructure automation, performance optimization, and continuous reliability improvement.
  
  
The ideal candidate should have experience working in production-critical environments where system availability, quick incident resolution, effective monitoring, and preventive engineering are essential.
  
  
Key Responsibilities1. Site Reliability and Production Operations
  
  

* Monitor production systems and maintain service availability, performance, and operational stability.
* Participate in production support and scheduled on-call rotations, including the resolution of critical incidents.
* Investigate system failures, perform root cause analysis, document post-incident findings, and implement preventive measures.
* Identify recurring operational issues and reduce manual intervention through automation.
* Improve service reliability using measurable indicators, service objectives, availability targets, and error-budget practices.
* Contribute to capacity planning, disaster recovery, high availability, redundancy, and failover strategies.
* Cloud Infrastructure and Platform Engineering
* Manage and optimize cloud infrastructure across Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services (AWS), and/or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
* Work with cloud compute, storage, networking, access management, monitoring, and cloud-native services.
* Support containerized applications and manage Kubernetes-based infrastructure, including AKS, EKS, GKE, or equivalent platforms.
* Troubleshoot cluster health, application workloads, resource utilization, scaling, networking, and deployment-related issues.
* Work with Helm and other relevant deployment tools to maintain consistent application releases.
* Infrastructure Automation and DevOps
* Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform.
* Support automated infrastructure provisioning, configuration management, and repeatable deployment processes.
* Work with Git-based development workflows, including GitHub, GitLab, Azure Repos, or equivalent platforms.
* Contribute to CI/CD pipelines and improve deployment reliability through automation.
* Develop scripts using Python and/or Bash to simplify operational activities and eliminate repetitive tasks.
* Monitoring, Observability and Performance
* Build and maintain monitoring, logging, metrics, tracing, and alerting solutions for production environments.
* Work with observability platforms such as OpenTelemetry, Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana, Azure Monitor, Golden Signals(including Latency, errors, traffic, saturation), AWS CloudWatch, and GCP Cloud Monitoring.
* Apply the four Golden Signals—latency, traffic, errors, and saturation—to monitor service health and identify performance issues.
* Improve distributed tracing and establish meaningful alerts that reflect actual system health and user impact.
* Investigate performance bottlenecks across infrastructure, applications, networks, and distributed systems.
* Linux, Networking and Security
* Troubleshoot Linux-based systems and production infrastructure issues.
* Apply networking fundamentals, including DNS, TCP/IP, load balancing, SSL/TLS, and connectivity troubleshooting.
* Follow cloud security best practices for identity and access management, network segmentation, and secrets management.
* Support vulnerability remediation, security improvements, and compliance-related activities in collaboration with relevant teams.

Technical Environment
  
  
The role involves cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes, Terraform, scripting, production support, monitoring, and modern reliability engineering practices. Experience with one major cloud platform is important, while exposure to multiple cloud environments can be beneficial.
  
  
Additional exposure to Go (Golang), OpenSearch, ELK Stack, AI/ML production platforms, Azure AI services, AI Foundry, RAG-based workloads, and enterprise observability frameworks would be advantageous.

description:

As a Cloud Managed Services Engineer (L2) at NTT DATA, you'll play a critical role in ensuring our clients' cloud infrastructure runs smoothly. * Collaborate with internal teams to ensure successful project delivery and customer satisfaction.
* Design effective data models for optimal storage and retrieval, including data quality checks.
* Design, build, tune, and maintain data pipelines using Hadoop, Apache NiFi, or related data integration technologies.

* Prepare technical documentation, customer status reports, and knowledge-base articles.

* Experience querying data in HDFS environments using tools such as Apache Hive.
* Experience implementing MapReduce and Spark jobs.
* Experience setting up and managing multi-node Hadoop clusters.
* Experience in systems administration or DevOps using one or more open-source operating systems.
* Experience in data warehouse design, ETL (Extract, Transform, Load), and efficient data warehouse architecture.
* Experience implementing operational best practices, including alerting, monitoring, and metadata management.
* Strong understanding of enterprise security practices and solutions such as LDAP and Kerberos.
* Experience with configuration management tools such as Ansible, Puppet, or Chef.
* Familiarity with scripting languages such as Bash, Python, and/or Perl.
* Experience working with network-based APIs, preferably REST/JSON or XML/SOAP.
* Understanding of the Java ecosystem and enterprise tools, including debugging and profiling tools such as jstack, jmap, and jconsole, and logging and monitoring tools such as Log4j and JMX.
* Ability to translate customer requirements into technical requirements.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

**Good To Have**

* Experience with Apache NiFi.
* Knowledge of Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) concepts and practices.
* Knowledge of data management concepts, including data warehousing, ETL, and data integration.
* Experience with a compiled programming language, preferably a JVM-based language such as Java or Scala.
* Experience with streaming or micro-batch processing frameworks, preferably Kafka and Spark.

* Willingness to travel across the Asia-Pacific region and work with customers across multiple industries.
* Big Data Developers interested in systems administration and consulting are also encouraged to apply.

title: GenAI Lead
description:
Orion Innovation is a premier, award-winning, global business and technology services firm. Orion delivers game-changing business transformation and product development rooted in digital strategy, experience design, and engineering, with a unique combination of agility, scale, and maturity. We work with a wide range of clients across many industries including financial services, professional services, telecommunications and media, consumer products, automotive, industrial automation, professional sports and entertainment, life sciences, ecommerce, and education.
  
  
**Job Overview:**
We are seeking an innovative and highly skilled
**Lead Generative AI (GenAI) Engineer**
to spearhead the design, development, and deployment of advanced AI-powered solutions. In this role, you will lead a team of engineers and data scientists to harness cutting-edge Generative AI technologies and implement them to solve complex business problems, enhance user experiences, and drive innovation. This role combines deep technical expertise, leadership, and a strong understanding of AI trends and tools.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Technical Leadership:

+ Lead the end-to-end design and implementation of Generative AI solutions.
+ Provide technical guidance and mentorship to engineers and data scientists working on GenAI projects.
+ Stay updated with the latest trends, research, and advancements in Generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs).

* Solution Development:

+ Architect, train, and fine-tune state-of-the-art LLMs and generative AI models
+ Develop and optimize pipelines for prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and domain-specific fine-tuning.
+ Develop and deploy generative AI models, particularly focusing on ChatGPT, using Python on Azure or AWS Platform or .Net on Azure platform
+ Ensure scalability, performance, and security of AI solutions deployed in production.
+ Integration and Deployment:

* API Development:

+ Ability to define and deliver API access for GenAI services, facilitating integration with other systems and applications.
+ Collaborate with software engineering teams to integrate GenAI solutions into enterprise applications and services.
+ Utilize cloud platforms (e.g., Azure, AWS, or GCP) to deploy and manage AI models and APIs.
+ Leverage MLOps practices for continuous model monitoring, retraining, and improvement.

* Data Strategy and Preparation:

+ Collaborate with data engineering teams to ensure high-quality data acquisition, preprocessing, and augmentation for model training and fine-tuning.
+ Implement data governance and privacy practices in line with organizational policies.

* Innovation and Research:

+ Experiment with new generative AI techniques, such as multimodal AI, reinforcement learning with human feedback (RLHF), and active learning.
+ Evaluate and recommend AI frameworks, libraries, and platforms for project requirements.

* Stakeholder Collaboration:

+ Work closely with product managers, business stakeholders, and UX designers to define AI-powered product features and use cases.
+ Present technical concepts, project progress, and AI capabilities to non-technical audiences.

**Key Requirements**

* Hands-on experience with cloud platforms and services for AI/ML, such as Azure AI Services, Azure Machine Learning, AWS Bedrock, or Google Vertex AI.
* Hands on experience in any of LLMs such as OpenAI’s ChatGPT Models , Gemini, Llama 2 ,Claude 2 ,Grok
* Hands on experience in any of the agentic frameworks like LangChain, Semantic kernel, AutoGen, CrewAi
* Hands on experience using any of vector database like Chroma, Pinecone, Weaviate, Faiss
* Experience with multimodal AI and advanced techniques like Tree-of-Thoughts, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), or Reinforcement Learning with Human Feedback (RLHF)
* Strong expertise in LLMs and generative AI frameworks like OpenAI, Hugging Face Transformers, or similar platforms.
* Deep understanding of natural language processing (NLP) concepts, including tokenization, embeddings, and sequence-to-sequence models.
* Proficiency in Python and libraries such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, and Scikit-learn.
* Experience in CI/CD pipeline management and automation tools, particularly within the Azure DevOps environment. Knowledge of containerization (e.g., Docker) and orchestration tools is also important
* Familiarity with MLOps tools and practices, such as MLflow, Kubeflow, or Docker.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or a related field (Ph.D. preferred).
* 8+ years of experience in AI/ML engineering, with 2+ years specifically in Generative AI.
* Minimum of 2 years of experience in building Conversational AI applications using cloud-based services and in orchestrating AI/ML services for building a complete solution
* Minimum of 6 years of extensive full-time experience in Data Analysis, Statistics, Machine Learning, or Computer Science
* Proven track record of leading AI projects from inception to production.
* Experience with multimodal AI and advanced techniques like Tree-of-Thoughts, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), or Reinforcement Learning with Human Feedback (RLHF).
* Certifications in AI/ML or cloud platforms (e.g., Azure AI Engineer, AWS Certified Machine Learning).

title: Operating System Engineer
description:
Required Background and Prior Experience

We are seeking a hands-on engineer who has previously built and supported production healthcare software comparable to VerityOS.

1. Relevant healthcare product experience — mandatory

The candidate must have personally developed substantial components of a live U.S. healthcare product involving one or more of the following:

\* Practice management.

\* Medical billing and revenue cycle management.

\* EHR-connected patient engagement and operational workflows.

The product must have been used by real healthcare organizations. Coursework, prototypes, chatbot demonstrations, and internal proof-of-concept projects alone do not qualify.

2. Billing and RCM engineering experience — mandatory

The candidate must have hands-on experience implementing healthcare billing workflows, including:

\* Claim creation/submission and acknowledgment or rejection handling.

\* Electronic remittance or EOB processing and payment posting.

\* Denial management and accounts-receivable workflows.

\* Patient balances, adjustments, and reconciliation.

They must understand the distinction between charges, claims, payments, adjustments, and patient responsibility, and explain how their system prevented duplicate transactions and preserved financial history.

They do not need to have built every billing component independently, but must clearly identify the components they personally implemented.

3. EHR or healthcare-system integration experience — mandatory

The candidate must have delivered at least one production integration with an EHR, practice-management system, or healthcare clearinghouse.

Relevant experience includes approved APIs, FHIR, HL7, healthcare transaction interfaces, or secure data exchanges.

They must demonstrate experience with patient matching, synchronization, conflicting updates, failed transactions, and reconciliation. General API experience alone is insufficient.

4. Secure application architecture — mandatory

The candidate must have implemented:

\* Role-based permissions and server-side access controls.

\* Audit trails and sensitive-data protection.

\* Separation of customer organizations’ data.

\* Secure credential management.

\* Backup, recovery, monitoring, and incident handling.

Experience with a platform serving multiple independent practices or customer organizations is strongly preferred.

5. Hands-on full-stack development — mandatory

The candidate must be able to personally design databases, develop backend services and user interfaces, write meaningful tests, deploy applications, and troubleshoot production issues.

This is a building role, not solely a project-management, consulting, or architecture role.

6. Production ownership — mandatory

The candidate must have supported a product after launch, including resolving incidents, releasing upgrades, managing database changes, and maintaining integrations.

They should be able to describe a significant production failure, its impact, how it was resolved, and what was changed to prevent recurrence.

7. Workflow automation experience — mandatory

The candidate must have built workflows involving task assignment, statuses, deadlines, escalation, document handling, and external-system events.

They must understand how to handle retries, duplicate events, incomplete information, and human review.

8. AI and communications experience — strongly preferred

Preference will be given to candidates who have deployed:

\* AI document extraction with validation.

\* Tool-using AI agents with defined permissions and human handoff.

\* Voice agents or telephony integrations.

\* Two-way SMS, e-fax, or secure patient messaging.

Candidates must distinguish production deployments from experimental projects.

9. Patient-facing and specialty experience — preferred

Relevant additional experience includes patient portals, caregiver access, scheduling, authorization workflows, procedure-resource scheduling, infusions, or other specialty-practice operations.

Neurology experience is valuable but not mandatory.

Evidence required with the application

Please provide two relevant project examples. For each, describe:

\* The product and type of healthcare organization it served.

\* Whether it reached production and how long you supported it.

\* Your exact role and the components you personally built.

\* EHRs, clearinghouses, or communications systems integrated.

\* The scale of deployment, where disclosure is permitted.

\* A difficult technical problem and how you resolved it.

\* A professional reference who can verify your contribution.

Confidential client names may be withheld initially. Use anonymized descriptions and synthetic data; do not disclose patient information or proprietary code.

title: Manager - Cloud Operations Lead
description:
****Job Summary****
At Sun Pharma, we commit to helping you “
**Create your own sunshine**
”— by fostering an environment where you grow at every step, take charge of your journey and thrive in a supportive community.
  
  
****Are You Ready to Create Your Own Sunshine?****
As you enter the Sun Pharma world, you’ll find yourself becoming ‘Better every day’ through continuous progress. Exhibit self-drive as you ‘Take charge’ and lead with confidence. Additionally, demonstrate a collaborative spirit, knowing that we ‘Thrive together’ and support each other’s journeys.”
  
  
****Job Summary:****
We are looking for a hands-on Cloud Operations Lead to run the day-to-day operations of our AWS-primary cloud estate (with a fast-growing Azure footprint) and to own and drive DevSecOps across the organisation. Reporting to the Cloud Architect within the Cloud CoE, the role spans three areas: cloud operations (about half the role), cloud-security remediation (about a quarter), and DevSecOps ownership, adoption and governance (about a quarter). In practice that means running the reliability and cost-efficiency of the cloud estate, closing security findings and hardening the environment, and owning the DevSecOps toolchain while driving its adoption and governance across delivery teams. It is a deeply technical, execution-focused role for an engineer equally comfortable in infrastructure-as-code, pipeline security, incident response, and directing a managed-services partner pool.
  
  
On the operations side, you will operate and continuously improve the landing zones, networking, and platform services designed by the Cloud Architect — primarily on AWS, and increasingly on Azure as that estate grows. You will run monitoring and observability, drive incident, problem, and change management to resolution, and enforce operational guardrails, patching, and backup/DR routines across environments. You will act as the operational owner of the NTT DATA cloud and DevSecOps managed-services pool, holding the partner to SLAs and quality standards.
  
  
On the security and DevSecOps side, you will remediate cloud-security findings and harden the estate, and own the DevSecOps toolchain and practice end-to-end — building and maintaining secure CI/CD pipelines, integrating SAST, DAST, SCA, secrets-scanning, and image/container security into the delivery flow, and shifting security left. You will define secure-pipeline standards, onboard and enable delivery teams, and actively drive DevSecOps adoption and maturity across the organisation, in line with CISO requirements. Across both halves of the role you will maintain infrastructure-as-code, automate operational toil, support cloud cost/FinOps optimisation, and work within the architecture standards and guardrails set by the Cloud Architect and the Enterprise Architecture Review Board (EARB), escalating design changes rather than making them unilaterally.
  
  
**Areas Of Responsibility**
**Area of Responsibility**
****Responsibilities****
**Cloud Operations & Reliability (~50%)**
Operate and maintain the AWS-primary cloud estate (and growing Azure footprint) for reliability and availability against agreed SLOs.
  
  
Own monitoring, alerting, and observability across infrastructure and platform services.
  
  
Drive incident, problem, and change management to timely resolution, including on-call/major-incident response.
  
  
Operate landing zones, networking, and platform services within the guardrails set by the Cloud Architect.
  
  
Maintain infrastructure-as-code (Terraform primary; CloudFormation / Bicep / ARM) to provision and change environments consistently.
  
  
**Automation & Platform Engineering**
Automate operational toil across provisioning, monitoring, and scaling.
  
  
Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for infrastructure and platform deployments in collaboration with DevOps/DevSecOps.
  
  
Perform operational debugging, root-cause analysis, and performance tuning; document runbooks and share operational knowledge.
  
  
Operate backup, restore, and disaster-recovery routines; verify recoverability and data availability.
  
  
Implement and maintain configuration management and environment consistency across dev, test, and production.
  
  
Maintain platform health across integrated components and dependencies.
  
  
Track operational metrics and keep stakeholders informed of service health and incidents.
  
  
**Cloud Security Remediation & Hardening (~25%)**
Implement and operate cloud security and DevSecOps controls in line with CISO requirements.
  
  
Own the cloud-security remediation backlog: triage findings from CSPM, Security Hub / Defender, and CISO reviews, and drive them to closure within SLA.
  
  
Apply patching, hardening, and encryption/key-management routines across the estate.
  
  
Remediate vulnerabilities and misconfigurations across accounts/subscriptions; harden baselines and prevent regression.
  
  
Continuously monitor cloud posture (CSPM) and report remediation status, risk burn-down, and exceptions to the CISO office.
  
  
Ensure controls and remediation evidence are audit-ready (GxP, GDPR, HIPAA); support security reviews and audits.
  
  
**Scalability and Performance**
Optimise platform performance, scaling, and resource utilisation against SLOs.
  
  
Perform capacity planning and autoscaling configuration for cloud workloads.
  
  
Identify and resolve operational bottlenecks; right-size resources for cost and performance.
  
  
**DevSecOps Ownership, Adoption & Governance (~25%)**
Own the DevSecOps toolchain end-to-end and integrate security scanning (SAST, DAST, SCA, secrets, IaC scanning) into CI/CD pipelines.
  
  
Embed image/container and Kubernetes security (registry scanning, admission controls, policy-as-code) into the delivery flow.
  
  
Define secure-pipeline standards and reusable templates; maintain release hygiene for continuous, safe delivery.
  
  
Drive DevSecOps adoption across delivery teams: onboard projects, run enablement, and track maturity uptake.
  
  
Establish and report DevSecOps KPIs (pipeline coverage, scan pass rates, mean-time-to-remediate, adoption %).
  
  
Manage secrets, keys, and certificates and enforce supply-chain security (SBOM, dependency and artifact integrity).
  
  
Own DevSecOps governance: define policy, standards, and gates in coordination with the CISO and EARB, and enforce them across teams.
  
  
**Continuous Improvement & Vendor Oversight**
Own the NTT DATA cloud managed-services pool: assign work, hold to SLAs, and review quality.
  
  
Track operational best practices and drive continuous improvement of run processes.
  
  
Propose and implement automation and tooling improvements to reduce toil and cost.
  
  
Pilot operational tooling (monitoring, FinOps, automation) with the Cloud Architect’s endorsement.
  
  
Feed operational insights back into architecture and standards via the Cloud Architect / EARB.
  
  
**Stakeholder Collaboration, Communication and Reporting**
Interface with application, infrastructure, and business teams to understand operational needs.
  
  
Coordinate with external partners, vendors, and technology providers on operational delivery.
  
  
Coordinate cross-functional teams during incidents, changes, and releases.
  
  
Ensure operations meet agreed service levels and business expectations.
  
  
Clearly communicate service health, incidents, and root causes to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  
  
Provide regular operational reporting (availability, incidents, cost) to the Cloud Architect and management.
  
  
**Operational Delivery & Run Management**
Own operational delivery of the cloud run function, including SLAs and service reviews.
  
  
Ensure operational commitments are met within agreed timelines and budget.
  
  
Manage the managed-services pool and schedules for operational execution.
  
  
**Travel Estimate**
**Job Scope**
**Internal Interactions (within the organization)**
Function Heads, business vertical leads/end users , procurement , SUN Infrastructure Teams (Network, Server, Database, Security), vendor payment, commercial, SAP support & other as necessary
  
  
**External Interactions (outside the organization)**
OEM, SI’s others partners/vendors/service providers in the space as applicable
  
  
**Geographical Scope**
Global
  
  
**Financial Accountability (cost/revenue with exclusive authority)**

* Cost Management:
* Execute cloud cost/FinOps optimisation: right-sizing, reserved-capacity actions, and waste elimination.
* Monitor daily cloud expenditure and enforce tagging, budgets, and lifecycle policies on storage and compute.
* Provide regular cost analysis and anomaly alerts to identify savings, escalating structural decisions to the Cloud Architect.
* Budgeting and Forecasting:
* Assist in preparing and tracking the cloud services run budget.
* Forecast run-rate cloud costs and flag variances early.
* Ensure operational cloud spend stays aligned to approved budgets.
* Vendor and Contract Management:
* Manage day-to-day relationship and tickets with cloud service providers.
* Support commercial reviews with usage data; recommend cost actions (final negotiation owned by the Cloud Architect / management).

Track consumption against contractual commitments and flag over/under-utilisation.
  
  
****Job Requirements****
**Educational Qualification**
**Specific Certification**
Mandatory Certifications
**(at least 01 in each group)**

* Cloud Certification (one or more of the following):

+ AWS Certified SysOps Administrator – Associate
+ AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate (Azure Administrator AZ-104 a plus, given the growing Azure estate)
+ Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA)
+ Security Certification (one or more of the following):

  
  

+ AWS Certified Security – Specialty (or CCSP)
+ DevSecOps / pipeline security credential — e.g. GitLab Security Specialist, GitHub Advanced Security, or Certified DevSecOps Professional (CDP)
+ DevOps Certification (one or more of the following):

  
  

+ AWS Certified DevOps Engineer – Professional
+ HashiCorp Certified: Terraform Associate
+ Microsoft Certified: DevOps Engineer Expert (AZ-400) — value-add for Azure

Optional Certifications (any one of more of below will be a value add))
  
  

+ ITIL 4 Foundation (service operations)
+ FinOps Certified Practitioner

****Experience****
6–10 years in cloud operations / cloud engineering, running production cloud environments (AWS primary; Azure growing). Blend of experience across the three areas of this role: cloud operations (~50% — monitoring, incident/change, IaC, vendor oversight), cloud-security remediation (~25% — CSPM/vulnerability closure, hardening, CISO-aligned), and DevSecOps (~25% — CI/CD security, toolchain ownership, adoption and governance).
  
  

* Skill (Functional & Behavioural):

Functional Skills
  
  

+ Cloud Operations: Hands-on expertise operating AWS (primary) and Azure (growing) — landing zones, networking, compute, storage, and platform services in production.
+ Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Strong hands-on skills with Terraform (primary) and CloudFormation (Bicep / ARM a plus) to provision and change infrastructure.
+ Monitoring & Observability: Proficiency with AWS CloudWatch (Azure Monitor / Log Analytics a plus), Grafana/Prometheus or equivalent; alerting and SLO management.
+ Incident, Problem & Change Management: Practical ITIL-aligned operations, including on-call and major-incident handling and RCA.
+ DevOps & Automation: CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps / GitHub Actions / GitLab CI), scripting (PowerShell / Bash / Python) to automate operational tasks.
+ Containers & Networking: Working knowledge of Kubernetes/AKS and cloud networking (VNet/VPC, subnets, VPN, load balancing, DNS, firewalls).
+ DevSecOps (~25%): Owning CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI / GitHub Actions / Jenkins / AWS CodePipeline) with integrated SAST, DAST, SCA, secrets and IaC scanning; container/K8s security; secure-pipeline standards; and driving org-wide adoption. Plus cloud security operations — patching, hardening, key management, and CSPM remediation under CISO guidance.
+ Cost / FinOps & Vendor Oversight: AWS Cost Explorer / Budgets (Azure Cost Management a plus), tagging/lifecycle governance; directing a managed-services (e.g., NTT DATA) pool to SLAs.
+ Behavioural Skills

  
  


* Analytical Thinking: Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to analyse complex technical issues and make data-driven decisions.
* Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
* Collaboration and Teamwork: Proven ability to work effectively in cross-functional teams and collaborate with various stakeholders.
* Adaptability: Quick learner who can adapt to new technologies and methodologies, and adjust to changing project requirements.
* Ownership & Vendor Management: Strong operational ownership and the ability to direct and hold a managed-services partner to account (rather than line-managing a Sun team).
* Attention to Detail: High level of accuracy and commitment to maintaining high standards in technical implementations.
* Customer Focus: Understanding of business requirements and dedication to providing excellent support and service to internal and external customers.

**Your Success Matters to Us**
At Sun Pharma, your success and well-being are our top priorities! We provide robust benefits and opportunities to foster personal and professional growth. Join us at Sun Pharma, where every day is an opportunity to grow, collaborate, and make a lasting impact. Let’s create a brighter future together!
  
  
**Disclaimer:**
The preceding job description has been designed to indicate the general nature and level of work performed by employees within this classification. It is not designed to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities, and qualifications required of employees as assigned to this job. Nothing herein shall preclude the employer from changing these duties from time to time and assigning comparable duties or other duties commensurate with the experience and background of the incumbent(s).

title: Application Engineer, Vice President
description:
**About This Role**
BlackRock’s Post Trade & Accounting group is seeking a Vice President-level engineering leader to advance our enterprise Client Reporting platform. This role encompasses technical leadership, system design, and direct coding responsibilities, enabling the development of robust, event-driven platforms that deliver reliable solutions for institutional and Aladdin clients globally. You will lead development of core platform capabilities across distributed services and data systems, shaping long-term architecture for a mission-critical platform where scale, accuracy, resiliency, and auditability are essential. You will also partner across product and operations to drive modernization, automation, and AI-enabled engineering practices. About the Team The Client Reporting team delivers and manages BlackRock’s enterprise Client Reporting platform, providing end-to-end reporting solutions for a diverse global base of accounting and institutional clients. We oversee the full lifecycle of report production and distribution—ensuring quality, scalability, and operational excellence through advanced QC workflows, exception management tools (including the Aladdin dashboard), and robust monitoring frameworks. The team manages reporting inventory and KPIs, supports both standardized and highly customized data sets, and enables access to reporting-ready data through digital portals and reporting libraries. We also power a dynamic self-service experience, offering secure document delivery via API, SFTP, and Secure Links, along with flexible tools for client-driven report configuration and branding. By owning the critical systems and processes behind client reporting, the team plays a central role in shaping client experience, driving automation and innovation, and delivering scalable, resilient solutions for industry-leading clients. What You’ll Do Lead development, architecture, and design of distributed, event-driven systems (Java/Python) Evolve scalable microservices and API-first platforms aligned to enterprise strategy Architect high-throughput data systems integrating SQL/NoSQL, streaming, and caching technologies Drive performance, resiliency, observability, and production excellence Provide full-stack technical Enterprise-grade container orchestration platform supporting declarative infrastructure and horizontal scaling, CI/CD) Strong stakeholder management and cross-functional influence skills Demonstrated horizontal scaling, Azure/AWS/GCP) Exposure to CI/CD and observability tooling Interest in financial systems, reporting platforms, or investment processes
  
  
**Our Benefits**
To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.
  
  
**Our hybrid work model**
BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.
  
  
**Guidance on AI use for candidates**
At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided
**guidance**
on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.
  
  
**About BlackRock**
At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.
  
  
This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.
  
  
To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok.
  
  
BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, disability, family status, gender identity, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation and other protected attributes at law.

title: Senior Wintel Engineer
description:

Role/Job Title: Senior Wintel Engineer
  
  
Function/ Department: Information Technology
  
  
Location: Navi Mumbai – Airoli Processing Centre (Gigaplex Office)
  
  
Job Summary: Unix Administrator – Information Technology

* Resolve major incidents and technical escalations within agreed SLAs and quality.

title: Research Engineer, Portfolio Management Group (PMG Tech), Associate
description:
**About This Role**
Your team
  
  
Portfolio Management Group Technology (PMG Tech) is the horizontal technology platform within BlackRock’s Portfolio Management Group. The team integrates portfolio management, risk management, and quantitative workflows with advanced engineering, artificial intelligence, and data capabilities, making technology a strategic driver of investment and risk outcomes.
  
  
Risk and Quantitative Analysis (RQA) provides independent oversight of BlackRock’s investment and enterprise risks through quantitative analysis, risk expertise, and evidence-based insights. In partnership with PMG Tech, RQA uses advanced engineering, artificial intelligence, and data platforms to enhance decision-making, strengthen risk management capabilities, and scale innovative solutions across investment, operational, technology, and enterprise risk domains.
  
  
Your role and impact
  
  
As a Research (AI) Engineer, you will partner with RQA, PMG Tech, and business stakeholders to develop data workflows, analytics solutions, and artificial intelligence-assisted capabilities that transform risk and quantitative challenges into actionable insights.
  
  
Embedded within a PMG Tech Pod, a business-focused, cross-functional team, you will collaborate with risk managers, quantitative analysts, artificial intelligence leads, and engineers. You will deliver high-quality data assets, analytical tools, and technology solutions that support risk management and informed decision-making.
  
  
This role requires an understanding of business problems and risk workflows, along with the ability to translate requirements into scalable data solutions. You will use Python, Structured Query Language (SQL), cloud data platforms, workflow orchestration, and visualization tools to develop and operate data-intensive applications. You will also apply data quality practices, continuous integration and continuous delivery processes, and data operations to create reliable, production-grade solutions.
  
  
Your responsibilities
  
  
**Responsibilities**
In every role at BlackRock, you'll be expected to apply sound judgement and critical thinking to solve complex problems, adapt as the business evolves, and combine the curiosity to explore new approaches and technologies with the rigor to challenge the results. The scope of this role also includes the following responsibilities:
  
  

* Build and maintain web-harvesting processes, data pipelines, transformations, and workflows that support research hypotheses and data analysis.
* Develop platform capabilities that source high-quality data and create scalable, reliable, and maintainable data solutions.
* Create research utilities, prototypes, dashboards, and exploratory tools that support insight generation and research workflows.
* Engage with investors, researchers, risk managers, and quantitative analysts to understand their workflows and translate business requirements into effective data solutions.
* Collaborate with core engineering teams to adopt data-extraction and data-management capabilities that accelerate investment research.
* Partner with artificial intelligence leads to source data and build applications that supplement research with artificial intelligence-assisted insights.

Your experience
  
  

* Strong programming capabilities in Python and Structured Query Language, supported by analytical thinking and effective problem-solving skills.
* Demonstrated experience in data engineering, data analytics, or the development of data-intensive applications.
* Knowledge of, or curiosity about, investment research and risk-management workflows or similar domains.
* Proven ability to collaborate effectively across engineering, research, and business teams and translate requirements into scalable technical solutions.
* A bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, data science, data engineering, or a related field.
* Experience with web-harvesting techniques and cloud data platforms such as Snowflake, BigQuery, Google Cloud Platform, and Google Cloud Storage.
* Exposure to artificial intelligence and machine learning tooling, large language model experimentation, retrieval-augmented generation, summarization, and question-and-answer applications. Experience with dashboards, notebooks, lightweight research tools, enterprise-grade container orchestration platforms supporting declarative infrastructure and horizontal scaling, or directed acyclic graph-based workflow orchestration frameworks for data and batch processing is beneficial.

**Our Benefits**
To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.
  
  
**Our hybrid work model**
BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.
  
  
**Guidance on AI use for candidates**
At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided
**guidance**
on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.
  
  
**About BlackRock**
At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.
  
  
This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.
  
  
To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok.
  
  
BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, disability, family status, gender identity, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation and other protected attributes at law.

description:

**Overview**
TNS Automation Development is seeking a senior, hands-on engineering leader to own and evolve the platforms, infrastructure, and software delivery capabilities behind our network automation strategy. Our automation ecosystem supports more than 70,000 network devices. This role combines deep technical ownership with leadership across platform reliability, cloud architecture, DevSecOps, release management, and operational excellence. * Lead platform upgrades, plugin lifecycle management, performance tuning, capacity planning, resiliency, and observability improvements.

**DevOps & Software Delivery**

* Build and manage application images, containers, and deployment workflows.
* Own GitLab standards, branching strategy, runners, CI/CD pipelines, release promotion, and software delivery practices.
* Establish reliable release processes across development, test, and production environments.

**Cloud, Security & Risk**

* Partner with Global Systems and cloud teams to evolve AWS infrastructure, hosting models, scalability, disaster recovery, and operational support.
* Own and manage AWS infrastructure supporting network automation platforms, including IAM roles and policies, EKS, EC2, VPC networking, security groups, S3, load balancing, and platform monitoring.
* Embed DevSecOps practices, including SAST, dependency scanning, container scanning, and infrastructure security validation.
* Ensure platform and deployment practices align with corporate security policies and audit requirements.

**Technical Leadership**

* Serve as the senior technical authority for platform engineering and DevOps within the Automation team.
* Set engineering standards and guardrails, mentor developers, and influence the future of network automation at TNS.

**Qualifications**
**Required Experience**

* 10+ years of progressive IT engineering experience, including 5+ years of hands-on DevOps or platform engineering.
* Proven experience deploying and operating production applications on Kubernetes.
* Strong hands-on experience with AWS, Terraform, Helm, Docker, Git, GitLab administration, runners, and CI/CD pipeline design.
* Strong hands-on AWS experience including IAM, EKS, EC2, VPCs, S3, security controls, monitoring, and cloud networking.
* Hands-on Experience operating distributed application platforms using Kubernetes, Celery, Redis, and containers.
* Experience implementing DevSecOps practices and security scanning across the software lifecycle.
* Experience supporting highly available production applications with demanding operational requirements.
* Ability to lead architecture decisions, solve complex platform problems, and guide engineers through implementation.

**Preferred Experience**

* Nautobot, NetBox, or comparable network source-of-truth platforms.
* Network automation and orchestration, including Ansible.
* Python and Django applications; PostgreSQL or MongoDB.
* GitLab Runner architecture and management; Argo-based deployment workflows.
* Enterprise platforms operating in regulated environments.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Within the first 12 months, you will:
* Lead the transition of the Nautobot AWS/Kubernetes platform from vendor-managed operations to a TNS-owned and operated service, including architecture, deployment, upgrades, security, monitoring, and lifecycle management.
* Standardize GitLab workflows, CI/CD pipelines, and release management.
* Provide clear technical leadership for platform engineering and automation infrastructure.
* Lead the AWS architecture and migration approach for applications, services, and infrastructure moving from on-premises and legacy environments.

title: Lead, AI Engineering
description:
*Application submission deadline, 26 October 2026*

**What Makes Us a Great Place to Work**

We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work. We are currently the top ranked consulting firm on
 


Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list

 
and have earned the #1 overall spot a record seven times. Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.

 

**About Bain AI, Insights & Solutions (AIS)**

Bain’s
 


AI, Insights & Solutions (AIS) team

 

works with clients to design and deliver AI-powered solutions that create measurable business impact. You’ll operate in multidisciplinary teams alongside Bain consultants, other experts in product, design, architecture and engineering, and client stakeholders, translating ambiguous business problems into r

obust AI applications that can be piloted, scaled, and adopted.

 

**The Impact You’ll Have**

Bain works with clients on board-level and executive priorities, helping deliver step-change results across growth, productivity, and resilience. In that context, AI is rarely a point solution. The most meaningful outcomes come from building AI as part of an integrated system that combines technology with redesigned processes, operating model changes, and adoption at scale across the organization.

  

As an AI Engineer in AIS, you will build the technical core of these transformations and work as part of broader Bain consulting teams to move solutions from prototype to real adoption. The result is measurable impact at the company or enterprise level and, in many cases, helps clients set new performance standards for their industries.

**The Role**

The Lead AI Engineer will design, build, and ship generative AI systems and agentic solutions for Bain’s clients. You will contribute across the full development lifecycle — from early experimentation and prototyping through to production deployment — collaborating closely with senior engineers, product managers, and data scientists. This is a hands-on individual contributor role with growing influence on technical direction and an opportunity to begin mentoring more junior team members.

  

You will have opportunities to work with major AI ecosystem partners through Bain’s partnerships, collaborating on real client deployments and helping shape how emerging capabilities are applied in enterprise settings.

  

Bain offers significant learning and growth opportunities through the breadth and depth of problems we solve, the level of impact we help clients achieve, and our apprenticeship model. You will learn by doing, with support from experienced teammates, frequent feedback, and increasing responsibility over time.

**What You’ll Do**

* Contribute to the design, development, and deployment of end-to-end generative AI systems, including multi-agent workflows and production-grade AI applications.
* Build and iterate on multi-component AI pipelines, including:
  + Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
  + Fine-tuning and parameter-efficient tuning
  + Embedding generation and optimization
  + Hybrid retrieval strategies (vector, graph, keyword)
* Implement reasoning, tool use, function calling, and orchestration across AI workflows
* Build and contribute to agentic systems, applying sound engineering principles around separation of concerns, memory architecture, and tool integration
* Contribute across the full stack: model experimentation, evaluation design, and production system deployment
* Build and maintain APIs, microservices, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud-native deployments with attention to observability and reliability
* Support and help build GenAIOps processes for automated testing, regression evaluation, latency monitoring, and continual improvement
* Balance performance, safety, responsible AI principles, and cost across system design:
  + Implement guardrails, fallbacks, red-teaming strategies, and human-in-the-loop (HITL) workflows
  + Partner with global ethics teams to ensure alignment with Bain’s Responsible AI standards
* Build automated evaluation suites integrating user signals, continual learning cycles, and ongoing model updates
* Design and implement evaluation frameworks covering:
  + Hallucination rate and factual consistency
  + Relevance and precision/recall
  + Latency, throughput, and system-level performance
  + Cost tracking and efficiency
* Partner closely with product, engineering, data science, ethics, and infrastructure teams to build robust, compliant AI systems
* Contribute technical insights and communicate findings clearly to cross-functional stakeholders and, where relevant, clients
* Share knowledge with peers and support a culture of technical learning around RAG, agents, prompt engineering, and AI safety

**What We’re Looking For (Qualifications)**

* 3–5+ years in software engineering, ML engineering, or applied AI roles with hands-on building responsibilities
* Demonstrated experience shipping generative AI features or systems end-to-end, from prototyping through production
* Clear communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical collaborators and stakeholders
* Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively across engineering, product, and data science teams; some experience supporting or informally mentoring peers is a plus
* Solid prompt engineering and context engineering skills; familiarity with conversation design principles
* Working knowledge of evaluation design, experimentation frameworks, and data labeling strategies for LLM applications
* Experience with:
  + RAG architectures (vector-based retrieval; exposure to hybrid or graph-based approaches is a plus)
  + Agentic patterns (tool use, routing, memory management; multi-agent systems experience is a plus)
  + ReAct, RLAIF, and other HITL + feedback loops.
  + AI-Specific Tools & Frameworks - Orchestration frameworks, Vector and graph databases and Model + API ecosystems
* Strong background in system design, architecture, and production-grade deployment
* Familiarity with cost and latency tradeoffs when working with LLM workloads
* Comfort operating in high-ambiguity environments with collaborative cross-functional teams
* Eagerness to grow into a technical leadership role and support junior team members
* Experience in client-facing consulting or enterprise transformation environments is a strong plus

  

**Working Model & Travel**

* This role requires a minimum of three days per week working together in person, either at a client location or at your Bain home office.
* Travel is required beyond your home office / primary working location. Frequency and destination vary by project needs.

**Job Description**
**Mactores**
is the agent-native AWS modernization firm. Most modernization work doesn't ship, it stalls in pilots, slips a year, or lands at three times the budget. We exist to ship it: production systems running, legacy retired, outcomes measured. Our delivery is built on Aedeon, the agent platform built by Mactores' founders' sister company, which absorbs the repetitive 60–70% of engagement work, discovery, dependency mapping, validation, test generation, that traditional consulting bills human hours against. Forward-deployed engineers own the rest: architecture, judgment, and cutover, on dates we commit to in the contract.
  
  
Legacy infrastructure doesn't retire itself. Someone has to build the pipelines, rehearse the cutover, and carry the release into production and that's this seat. As a Senior AWS DevOps Engineer, you serve our application and infrastructure modernization work: you own build and release cycles for customer projects, land migrations from legacy hardware to AWS, and make deployments boring in the best sense of the word.
  
  
Agents change what this job looks like day to day. Aedeon and automation handle the repetitive discovery, mapping, and validation work that used to eat engineer hours. That leaves you the parts that actually need a senior engineer: infrastructure architecture, risk tradeoffs, release judgment, and the operational standards the whole team ships against. You'll work client-facing, embedded with customer teams, and the delivery commitment is one you carry personally.
  
  
**What we are looking for?**

* 6+ Years of total Hands-On Experience in DevOps
* 4+ years with Terraform for Infrastructure as Code (IaC) including modules, remote state, state management, imports and multi account providers.
* Experience in designing highly available and secure AWS architecture within strong understanding of RTO/RPO and DR Strategies.
* 4+ years in configuration management and systems engineering, supporting large-scale Agile environments.
* 4+ years of Linux or Windows administration.
* 4+ years working with Git, with a solid grasp of branching and merging strategies.
* 4+ years hands-on with AWS infrastructure and platform services.
* 2+ years with cloud automation tools such as Ansible or Chef.
* 2+ years with container orchestration, Kubernetes (EKS), AWS ECS, and Docker.
* A proactive, solutions-oriented approach and a drive to improve reliability and scalability.

**What you will do?**

* Automate infrastructure creation with Terraform and AWS CloudFormation — infrastructure as code, not tickets and toil.
* Own application configuration management and drive Infrastructure as Code through deployment tooling.
* Own the build and release cycle for customer projects, end to end.
* Share responsibility for deploying releases and for operations and maintenance work.
* Improve the operations infrastructure we ship with — Jenkins clusters, Bitbucket, monitoring tools (Consul), and metrics tools like Graphite and Grafana.
* Support the engineering team operationally and help migrate legacy infrastructure to the cloud — retiring the old systems, not just standing up new ones.
* Establish and enforce operational best practices, and hold releases to them.
* Help hire culturally aligned engineers and mentor them as they grow.
* Work with the founders on team strategy and long-term technical planning.
* Work across US Mountain Time business hours with globally distributed teams., and with customer SMEs, to keep the business logic honest through migration.

title: Principal Data Consultant
description:

Data Platform / Trading Technology

We are seeking a
**Principal Data Engineer**
to design and build a next-generation proprietary data platform from the ground up at a global leading trading firm. You will create the systems, pipelines and automation needed to ingest, normalise, validate and deliver very large volumes of proprietary and alternative data across HFT, ETFs, options, indices, ecommerce, contracts and M&A.

This is a high-impact, hands-on leadership role. You will work directly with traders, quantitative researchers, engineers and business stakeholders to turn fragmented, complex and often unstructured data into reliable, low-latency, research-ready and trading-ready datasets.

You will combine strong data engineering with automation, Python development and practical use of LLMs and AI agents to accelerate ingestion, extraction, enrichment, classification and data-quality workflows.

**What You’ll Do**

* Define and deliver the technical architecture for a firm-wide proprietary data platform, covering ingestion, storage, transformation, cataloguing, lineage, access and delivery.
* Build high-volume, high-reliability batch and near-real-time data pipelines for market, reference, alternative and proprietary datasets.
* Design pipelines and data models for HFT-related data, including market data, order data, execution data, ETF, options and index data.
* Build data ingestion and enrichment systems for ecommerce, corporate contracts, M&A, filings, news and other unstructured or semi-structured sources.
* Work closely with traders and quants to understand research, alpha, risk, execution and trading-workflow requirements, then translate them into scalable data products.
* Build automated ingestion, parsing, normalisation, deduplication, validation and reconciliation frameworks.
* Develop production-grade Python services, tooling and pipeline components for data extraction, transformation, orchestration and quality control.
* Apply LLMs, embeddings and AI-agent workflows to extract structured information from documents, contracts, filings, web content and other unstructured sources.
* Build automated data-quality, anomaly-detection and lineage frameworks to ensure datasets
* Mentor data engineers and collaborate with infrastructure, quant, trading and software engineering teams.
* Stay hands-on: write code, debug complex pipeline issues, review designs and drive technical decisions.

**What We’re Looking For**

* Significant experience as a Principal, Staff, Lead or Senior Data Engineer, ideally within a trading firm, hedge fund, market maker, fintech or data-intensive technology business.
* Expert-level Python, with a track record of building clean, performant, production-grade data engineering systems.
* Deep experience designing and operating large-scale ETL/ELT pipelines across multiple internal and external data sources.
* Strong SQL and data-modelling skills, with experience across relational, columnar and/or NoSQL databases.
* Experience building data platforms or critical data infrastructure from scratch, rather than only maintaining existing systems.
* Strong understanding of data quality, reconciliation, lineage, metadata, schema evolution and automated validation.
* Experience processing structured, semi-structured and unstructured data, including APIs, files, web data, documents and event streams.
* Practical experience using LLMs or AI/ML techniques for extraction, classification, enrichment, search or workflow automation.

**Desirable Experience**

* Direct experience with financial datasets, including equities, ETFs, options, futures, indices, market data, reference data or alternative data.
* Exposure to HFT, electronic trading, execution, order-book or market-microstructure data.
* Experience with low-latency or high-throughput data systems.

title: Salesforce DevOps / Process Analyst, Assistant Manager
description:
**Job Summary**
We are seeking a Salesforce DevOps / Process Analyst with a minimum of 3+ years of experience in Salesforce release operations, deployment coordination, process governance, and platform support. The candidate must have practical exposure to both Salesforce development and administration to assess change impacts, support troubleshooting, coordinate releases, and improve delivery processes across development, QA, UAT, and production environments.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Salesforce DevOps & Release Management
  
  

* Coordinate Salesforce release activities across development, QA, UAT, staging, and production environments.
* Plan release scope, deployment schedules, prerequisites, validation activities, and post-deployment checks.
* Manage metadata deployments using approved Salesforce deployment and DevOps tools.
* Maintain version control practices, branching standards, pull requests, merge coordination, and release tagging.
* Identify deployment dependencies, metadata conflicts, test failures, and environment-specific issues.
* Coordinate rollback planning and support recovery activities when required.

Process Analysis & Governance
  
  

* Assess the existing software delivery lifecycle and recommend improvements to release, testing, approval, and support processes.
* Define and maintain release checklists, operating procedures, governance controls, and delivery documentation.
* Track change requests, approvals, risks, dependencies, defects, and release readiness.
* Support compliance, audit evidence, segregation-of-duties, and controlled change-management requirements.
* Monitor delivery metrics and identify recurring bottlenecks, manual activities, and automation opportunities.

Developer & Administrator Support
  
  

* Collaborate with Salesforce developers to review metadata dependencies involving Apex, Lightning Web Components, Aura components, triggers, test classes, integrations, and configuration.
* Collaborate with Salesforce administrators on objects, fields, page layouts, record types, validation rules, Flow, profiles, permission sets, reports, dashboards, and sharing settings.
* Perform initial analysis of deployment errors, test failures, user-access issues, data issues, and configuration defects.
* Support minor configuration changes and technical validations within approved access and change controls.
* Ensure required test coverage, deployment validation, peer review, and documentation are completed before release.

Environment & Configuration Management
  
  

* Coordinate sandbox refreshes, environment alignment, access readiness, and post-refresh configuration activities.
* Maintain environment inventories, deployment records, release calendars, and configuration baselines.
* Coordinate updates to endpoints, credentials, connected applications, integration settings, and scheduled jobs following environment changes.
* Help prevent configuration drift by comparing environments and promoting changes through controlled pipelines.

Testing, Support & Stakeholder Coordination
  
  

* Partner with business analysts, developers, administrators, QA, support, and product teams throughout the release lifecycle.
* Support test planning, defect triage, regression testing, UAT coordination, and production validation.
* Communicate release status, risks, dependencies, implementation outcomes, and issues to stakeholders.
* Provide production support for release-related incidents and facilitate root-cause analysis and corrective actions.
* Maintain knowledge articles and reusable troubleshooting guidance for common deployment and process issues.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Minimum 3+ years of experience in Salesforce DevOps, release management, Salesforce administration, development support, or process analysis.
* Hands-on exposure to Salesforce development concepts, including Apex, test classes, SOQL, Lightning Web Components, Aura, integrations, and deployment dependencies.
* Hands-on exposure to Salesforce administration, including objects, fields, security, Flow, validation rules, reports, dashboards, and data management.
* Experience with Git-based version control, branching, pull requests, merge conflict resolution, and code-review workflows.
* Experience supporting Salesforce deployments through change sets, Salesforce CLI, DevOps Center, Copado, Gearset, AutoRABIT, Azure DevOps, Jenkins, or comparable tools.
* Understanding of Salesforce metadata, sandbox strategy, release pipelines, deployment validation, and Apex test execution.
* Experience with Agile delivery, Jira or Azure DevOps work items, change requests, defect tracking, and release documentation.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, documentation, and stakeholder-management skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Salesforce Certified Administrator, Platform App Builder, Platform Developer I, or Salesforce DevOps-related certification.
* Experience supporting enterprise or financial-services Salesforce environments.
* Knowledge of CI/CD automation, static code analysis, quality gates, and automated testing practices.
* Familiarity with Salesforce APIs, integration middleware, connected apps, OAuth, and credential-management processes.
* Knowledge of ITIL practices, incident management, problem management, change management, and release governance.
* Experience supporting audit, risk, compliance, access review, and production-control requirements.

Key Competencies
  
  

* Salesforce release coordination
* CI/CD and version control
* Process analysis and governance
* Developer and admin collaboration
* Deployment troubleshooting
* Environment management
* Risk and change control
* Stakeholder communication

Success Measures
  
  

* Releases are delivered with complete approvals, evidence, validation, and stakeholder communication.
* Deployment failures and production issues are identified, documented, and resolved efficiently.
* Delivery processes become more consistent, traceable, controlled, and automated over time.
* Salesforce environments remain aligned and ready for planned development and release activities.

**Certification Preferred:**
Salesforce Certified Administrator and/or Platform Developer I.

Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.

* Train and coach team members both on technical and non-technical skills

* Support presales and post-sales field teams during workshops, proofs of concepts, pilots, and production deployments
