* Knowledge and some experience in OpenShift by Red Hat;
* Experience with another Platform-as-a-Service (PaaS) solution will also be considered

This isn't a typical analyst role. You'll apply your hands-on knowledge of CVEs, exposure management, and remediation workflows to help train and evaluate AI systems — ensuring they reason about security risk the way seasoned professionals actually do.
  
  
If you've spent time in the trenches triaging vulnerabilities, managing patch cycles, or prioritizing what actually matters in production environments, your expertise is exactly what we need.
  
  

* Organization: Alignerr
* Type: Hourly Contract
* Location: Remote
* Commitment: 10–40 hours/week

**What You'll Do**

* Analyze vulnerability reports, CVEs, and real-world exposure scenarios across infrastructure and applications
* Assess severity, exploitability, business impact, and appropriate remediation strategies
* Review and evaluate patching, mitigation, and risk prioritization decision-making scenarios
* Generate, label, and validate realistic security-reasoning data used to train and benchmark AI systems
* Apply your practical knowledge of what risk actually matters in production — not just theoretical CVSS scores

**Who You Are**

* 2+ years of hands-on experience in vulnerability management, security operations, or infrastructure security
* Solid understanding of CVEs, vulnerability scanners, patching workflows, and risk prioritization frameworks
* Able to articulate the real-world tradeoffs between theoretical risk scores and operational impact
* A structured, analytical thinker who communicates clearly in writing
* Self-directed and comfortable working asynchronously on task-based assignments

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with tools like Tenable, Qualys, Rapid7, or similar platforms
* Familiarity with frameworks such as CVSS, EPSS, CISA KEV, or NIST
* Background in cloud infrastructure, DevSecOps, or enterprise security operations
* Prior experience contributing to AI, data labeling, or research projects

**Why Join Us**

* Work directly on cutting-edge AI projects with top-tier research labs
* Fully remote and flexible — work on your own schedule
* Freelance perks: autonomy, variety, and global collaboration
* Make a meaningful contribution to how AI reasons about cybersecurity
* Potential for ongoing work and contract extension

title: Sr. Infrastructure Engineer – eApps
description:
**Company Overview**
We exist to make food the world loves. But we do more than that. Our company is a place that prioritizes being a force for good, a place to expand learning, explore new perspectives and reimagine new possibilities, every day. We look for people who want to bring their best — bold thinkers with big hearts who challenge one another and grow together. Because becoming the undisputed leader in food means surrounding ourselves with people who are hungry for what’s next.
  
  
**Overview**

* Lead the engineering, operation, and continuous improvement of infrastructure supporting third-party Enterprise Applications (E-Apps), with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) as the primary cloud environment.
* Own hands-on infrastructure engineering across cloud and hybrid environments, including secure design, provisioning, migration, deployment, capacity, reliability, and lifecycle management.
* Drive Infrastructure as Code and automation using Terraform as the primary tool, supported by Ansible, Python, and Shell scripting; use PowerShell where required for Windows administration.
* Partner with solution teams, Enterprise Applications stakeholders, security, network, and service teams to define hosting standards, technical specifications, operational readiness, and support models.
* Provide technical leadership, mentor engineers, and promote standardization, observability, ITSM discipline, and secure-by-design practices across the E-Apps platform.

**Key Accountabilities**

* Operate and continuously improve the E-Apps infrastructure estate, including availability, performance, capacity, resilience, disaster recovery, patching, upgrades, and platform lifecycle management.
* Design and provision GCP infrastructure using approved architecture and security patterns across compute, networking, IAM, load balancing, DNS, certificates, logging, monitoring, storage, and secrets management.
* Build reusable Terraform modules and deployment patterns and develop Ansible playbooks, Python utilities, and Shell scripts to eliminate manual work and improve deployment consistency.
* Administer and troubleshoot web and application platforms including IIS, JBoss, and Apache, with understanding of Java application hosting, reverse proxy configuration, SSL/TLS offload, certificates, ports, and application integrations.
* Implement observability and operational insight using Datadog and GCP monitoring/logging capabilities, including dashboards, metrics, logs, traces, alerting, health checks, service-level indicators, and actionable runbooks.
* Apply ITSM practices across incident, problem, change, service request, knowledge, and major-incident management; maintain accurate operational documentation and participate in governance and change reviews.
* Act as a senior escalation point for outages, complex incidents, root-cause analysis, vendor coordination, security findings, and recovery activities; drive permanent corrective actions.
* Establish standards and governance for configuration, access, automation, monitoring, vulnerability remediation, backup, recovery, and operational readiness of new and existing applications.
* Mentor team members and coordinate support coverage while promoting knowledge sharing, effective handoffs, and continuous improvement across the platform team.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Education: Full-time bachelor’s degree in engineering, computer science, information technology, or a related technical discipline from an accredited university.
* Experience: 8–12 years of experience designing, implementing, operating, and supporting complex infrastructure and enterprise application environments, including high-availability and mission-critical systems.
* GCP — primary requirement: Strong hands-on experience with GCP services and architecture, including Compute Engine, VPC networking, IAM, Cloud Load Balancing, Cloud DNS, SSL certificates, Cloud Monitoring, Cloud Logging, Secret Manager, storage, and hybrid connectivity.
* Terraform — primary engineering keyword: Demonstrated experience creating maintainable Infrastructure as Code, reusable modules, environment configuration, state management, policy controls, and automated provisioning at scale.
* Scripting and automation: Strong Shell scripting and Python experience for operational tooling, integrations, validations, remediation, and workflow automation; practical experience with Ansible for configuration management and application/platform automation.
* Web and application infrastructure: Hands-on understanding of IIS, JBoss, and Apache administration, configuration, troubleshooting, patching, reverse proxying, Java application hosting, SSL/TLS, certificates, load balancers, and integration with enterprise applications.
* Observability: Good hands-on experience with Datadog and/or equivalent observability platforms, covering monitoring, logging, tracing, dashboards, alerting, synthetic or endpoint checks, and incident correlation.
* ITSM and operations: Working knowledge of ITSM practices and operational controls, including incident, problem, change, service request, major-incident, SLA, knowledge-management, and root-cause-analysis processes.
* Systems and troubleshooting: Working knowledge of Linux and Windows Server, networking fundamentals, firewalls, DNS, identity/access, relational databases such as Oracle, SQL Server, or MySQL, and vendor-supported enterprise applications.
* Leadership: Ability to lead technical initiatives, manage competing priorities, communicate clearly with technical and business stakeholders, and mentor junior engineers.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Cloud breadth: Working knowledge of AWS and Azure administration; GCP remains the primary cloud requirement for the role.
* Delivery practices: Experience with CI/CD pipelines, source control, release automation, DevOps practices, and secure software delivery.
* Platform experience: Experience supporting SaaS, PaaS, IaaS, vendor-built applications, cloud migrations, and hybrid enterprise environments.
* Certifications: GCP, Terraform, Ansible, ITIL, or other relevant cloud and infrastructure certifications are desirable.
* Continuous improvement: Ability to use AI capabilities where they deliver business value and improve support, operations, and user productivity.
* Leadership behaviors: Demonstrates ownership, initiative, integrity, constructive challenge, collaboration, and an engaging leadership style; develops people and drives initiatives from idea through execution.

**SUPPORT REQUIREMENT**

* The role requires extended off-hours coverage, including overnight, weekend, and holiday on-call support on a weekly rotational basis, aligned to US business-hours support needs and the team’s operational support model.

**ELIGIBILITY**
Applicants must meet minimum age qualifications in the country in which the job is located.

description:
**Job Description**
WSP is seeking an Engineer AI (Mining Automation) to join the GCC Specialist Mining Services team, supporting the delivery of digital and automation solutions for global mining projects. Reporting to the Mining Automation Team Leader, the successful candidate will develop and implement AI-enabled workflows that improve the way mining, asset, operational, geotechnical, and technical information is processed, connected, analysed, and used for engineering decision-making.
  
  
The role combines mining-domain understanding with artificial intelligence, automation, data engineering, computer vision, knowledge extraction, and graph-based retrieval. The Engineer will collaborate with multidisciplinary teams across WSP to develop practical, scalable, traceable, and responsible solutions for mine planning, operations, tailings and water management, asset performance, risk management, and engineering delivery.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**AI and Mining Automation Development**

* Design, develop, and implement AI-enabled automation solutions for mining engineering and operational workflows.
* Work with mining specialists to identify high-value automation opportunities and convert technical requirements into practical digital solutions.
* Develop intelligent workflows that integrate geological, geotechnical, mine planning, operational, asset,

environmental, and risk information.
  
  

* Support the use of generative AI, machine learning, computer vision, and agent-based approaches to improve engineering productivity and decision support.
* Create reusable components and scalable solution patterns that can be applied across global mining projects.

**Data Extraction and Document Intelligence**

* Develop automated pipelines to extract information from mining reports, PDFs, scanned documents, drawings, tables, figures, inspection records, and monitoring outputs.
* Apply OCR, layout understanding, multimodal models, and LLM-based techniques to identify entities, attributes, relationships, measurements, risks, and supporting evidence.
* Implement validation, normalization, exception-handling, and quality-control logic to improve the accuracy and consistency of extracted information.
* Maintain traceability between extracted outputs and the relevant source documents, pages, figures, tables, or evidence.

**AI Models and Advanced Analytics**

* Develop, validate, and support deployment of machine learning solutions for predictive analytics, anomaly detection, classification, risk assessment, optimization, and asset insights.
* Apply data science and statistical methods to identify patterns, trends, and actionable insights from engineering and operational data.
* Evaluate model performance, limitations, and suitability for mining use cases, working with domain experts to confirm engineering relevance.
* Contribute to proof-of-concept development and the transition of successful prototypes into maintainable production solutions.

**Knowledge Management and Graph-Based Intelligence**

* Support the design of structured knowledge models that connect mining assets, technical information, operational data, risks, controls, and engineering evidence.
* Contribute to knowledge graph and semantic data solutions using RDF, OWL, SPARQL, or equivalent technologies where appropriate.
* Develop graph-native and hybrid retrieval workflows, including GraphRAG approaches that combine structured graph context with AI models.
* Enable natural-language access to connected mining knowledge for engineering assistants, analytics tools, and decision-support applications.
* Support provenance, versioning, evidence linking, and auditability of AI-generated or graph-derived outputs.

**Cloud, Data, and Platform Integration**

* Develop and integrate solutions using Azure AI services, Azure OpenAI, Azure Machine Learning, Azure AI

Document Intelligence, and related cloud capabilities, where applicable.
  
  

* Build and maintain data pipelines, APIs, connectors, and services that integrate AI workflows with engineering platforms and enterprise data environments.
* Contribute to deployment, monitoring, documentation, testing, and continuous improvement of production AI applications.
* Support MLOps, prompt and model evaluation, access control, data security, and responsible AI practices.

**Global Project Delivery and Collaboration**

* Work as part of the GCC Specialist Mining Services team to support multidisciplinary mining assignments delivered across WSP's global business.
* Collaborate with the Mining Automation Team Leader, mining engineers, geotechnical specialists, tailings

practitioners, data scientists, software developers, and digital teams.
  
  

* Engage with project and domain teams to understand technical context, refine use cases, review outputs, and align solutions with project requirements.
* Communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders across different regions and time zones.
* Prepare solution documentation, specifications, test records, user guidance, and knowledge-transfer materials.
* Contribute to internal standards, reusable assets, lessons learned, innovation initiatives, and capability

development within the team.
  
  
**Qualifications**
**Education**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mining Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence,

Software Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, or a related discipline.
  
  
**Technical Experience And Skills**

* Experience developing AI, machine learning, automation, data analytics, or document intelligence solutions in

mining, engineering, infrastructure, industrial, or asset-intensive environments.

title: Assistant Manager - Enterprise IT
description:
**Position Overview**
We require an experienced L2 Windows Domain & Backup Engineer to manage and maintain enterprise Windows environments along with backup and recovery infrastructure. The role includes Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, and core Windows services, along with enterprise backup administration, monitoring, and recovery operations. The engineer will also perform assessments, reporting, compliance activities, and enable automation using scripting/AI tools.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
Windows Infrastructure Management
  
  

* Administer Active Directory (Users, Groups, GPOs, OU structure)
* Maintain DNS, DHCP, and RADIUS (NPS) services
* Manage Windows Server environments (2016/2019/2022) including installation, configuration, and upgrades
* Ensure high availability and performance optimization of Windows infrastructure

Backup Administration
  
  

* Manage and monitor enterprise backup solutions (e.g., NetBackup, BackupExec, Veeam, Commvault, or similar)
* Perform backup scheduling, configuration, and policy management for servers, databases, and applications
* Ensure successful completion of daily backups and troubleshoot failed backup jobs
* Perform data restoration (file-level, VM-level, and application-level) as per business requirements
* Conduct regular backup validation and restoration drills to ensure recoverability
* Manage backup storage, retention policies, and archival processes
* Optimize backup performance and storage utilization
* Coordinate with application and infrastructure teams during backup and restore activities
* Ensure DR readiness by supporting disaster recovery drills and failover testing
* Maintain backup reports, logs, and documentation

Security & Vulnerability Management
  
  

* Perform Windows patch management (monthly/critical updates)
* Identify and remediate vulnerabilities using tools like Qualys/Nessus
* Ensure SLA-based closure of vulnerabilities
* Implement server hardening best practices
* Ensure backup data security, encryption, and access controls
* Ensure compliance with ISO 27001 and internal policies
* Prepare documentation for audits (including backup and recovery evidence)
* Track audit findings and remediation
* Maintain security and backup baselines

Incident & Change Management
  
  

* Handle L2/L3 incidents related to Windows infrastructure and backup systems
* Perform Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for failures (including backup failures)
* Support change management processes for infra and backup changes

**Required Qualifications**
**Technical Skills:**
Strong experience in Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, RADIUS/NPS; Windows Server (2016/2019/2022/2025); patch management tools (WSUS/SCCM/Intune/Bigfix)
  
  
**Backup Tools:**
Experience in enterprise backup tools (NetBackup, Veeam, Commvault, etc.)
  
  
**Security:**
Knowledge of ISO 27001 and security frameworks; experience with vulnerability tools (Qualys, Nessus)
  
  
**Scripting:**
PowerShell scripting for automation
  
  
**Certifications (Preferred):**
Microsoft certifications (MCSA, Azure Admin); certifications in backup technologies (Veeam/Commvault/NetBackup)
  
  
**Environment:**
Experience in enterprise multi-domain environments; exposure to hybrid environments (on-prem + Azure/GCP); exposure to AI/automation tools
  
  
**Key Skills & Competencies**
**Communication:**
Strong documentation and reporting skills; effective communication and coordination with IT and business teams
  
  
**Attention to Detail:**
High attention to detail in backup validation, security compliance, and audit readiness
  
  
**Resilience:**
Ability to work in high-pressure production environments with SLA-bound deliverables
  
  
**Problem-Solving:**
Root cause analysis; incident management; proactive vulnerability remediation

title: DevOps Lead
description:
**Hiring a Senior DevOps Leader for a High-Scale, Multi-Cloud Environment**

Finding the right Senior DevOps Leader for your organization, especially one with over 15 years of experience and a background in high-scale operations leveraging GitLab, Kubernetes, GCP, and AWS, is a critical undertaking. This role demands a unique blend of deep technical expertise, strategic thinking, and proven leadership capabilities. Here’s a comprehensive guide to what you should be looking for:

**Key Responsibilities to Expect:**

A Senior DevOps Leader in this context will be responsible for more than just managing infrastructure; they will be a strategic partner driving efficiency, innovation, and reliability across the organization.

* **Strategic Leadership & Vision:**
* Defining and executing a long-term DevOps strategy aligned with business objectives, particularly for high-scale and resilient systems.
* Driving the adoption of DevOps best practices, tools, and culture across engineering and operations teams.
* Leading architectural decisions for CI/CD, containerization, cloud infrastructure, and automation, ensuring scalability, security, and cost-effectiveness.
* Evaluating and integrating new and emerging technologies (e.g., AI in DevOps, advanced monitoring solutions) to enhance operational efficiency and system performance.
* **Team Leadership & Development:**
* Building, mentoring, and leading a high-performing team of DevOps engineers.
* Fostering a collaborative, innovative, and continuous improvement culture within the DevOps team and its interactions with other departments.
* Managing resource allocation, project prioritization, and performance management for the DevOps team.
* **Technical Oversight & Execution:**
* Overseeing the design, implementation, and management of robust CI/CD pipelines using GitLab CI.
* Leading the strategy and governance for Kubernetes deployments at scale, including cluster management, networking, security, and resource optimization across GCP (GKE) and AWS (EKS).
* Architecting and managing multi-cloud infrastructure (GCP and AWS), focusing on high availability, disaster recovery, security, and cost optimization.
* Championing Infrastructure as Code (IaC) practices using tools like Terraform or CloudFormation.
* Implementing and refining comprehensive monitoring, logging, and alerting strategies (e.g., using Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack, CloudWatch, Google Cloud's operations suite) to ensure system health and proactive issue resolution.
* Driving automation initiatives across all stages of the software development lifecycle.
* **Collaboration & Communication:**
* Working closely with development, operations, security, and product teams to streamline workflows and ensure seamless delivery of software.
* Communicating effectively with executive leadership, stakeholders, and technical teams regarding DevOps strategy, project status, risks, and performance metrics.
* Championing and enforcing security best practices (DevSecOps) throughout the development lifecycle.
* **Operational Excellence & Governance:**
* Establishing and tracking key DevOps metrics (e.g., deployment frequency, lead time for changes, mean time to recovery (MTTR), change failure rate).
* Ensuring compliance with industry standards and internal policies.
* Managing budgets and vendor relationships related to DevOps tools and cloud services.

**Essential Technical Leadership Skills:**

Beyond hands-on proficiency, a leader must demonstrate strategic application and governance of these technologies.

* **GitLab:**
* **Strategic Implementation:**
  Deep understanding of GitLab's full suite (beyond just CI/CD) for source code management, pipeline orchestration, security scanning, and package management in a large enterprise.
* **Scalability & Performance:**
  Experience in scaling GitLab infrastructure and optimizing its performance for a large number of users and projects.
* **Automation & Integration:**
  Proven ability to automate complex workflows and integrate GitLab with other development and operations tools.
* **Kubernetes (K8s):**
* **Large-Scale Cluster Management:**
  Expertise in designing, deploying, and managing multiple large-scale Kubernetes clusters on both GCP (GKE) and AWS (EKS). This includes experience with cluster upgrades, multi-tenancy, and resource quotas.
* **Advanced Networking & Security:**
  In-depth knowledge of Kubernetes networking (e.g., CNI, service mesh like Istio or Linkerd) and security best practices (e.g., pod security policies, network policies, secrets management, RBAC) in a high-scale, multi-cloud environment.
* **Ecosystem & Tooling:**
  Familiarity with the broader Kubernetes ecosystem, including Helm for package management, Prometheus/Grafana for monitoring, and tools for logging and tracing.
* **GitOps:**
  Experience implementing GitOps principles for managing Kubernetes configurations and applications.
* **Google Cloud Platform (GCP) & Amazon Web Services (AWS):**
* **Multi-Cloud Strategy & Governance:**
  Proven experience in developing and implementing multi-cloud strategies, including workload placement, data management, and consistent governance across GCP and AWS.
* **Core Services Expertise:**
  Deep understanding and experience with core compute, storage, networking, database, and security services on both platforms (e.g., AWS EC2, S3, VPC, RDS; GCP Compute Engine, Cloud Storage, VPC, Cloud SQL).
* **Infrastructure as Code (IaC):**
  Mastery of IaC tools like Terraform (preferred for multi-cloud) or CloudFormation (AWS-specific) for provisioning and managing infrastructure in both clouds.
* **Cost Optimization & Management:**
  Demonstrable experience in implementing cost optimization strategies and managing budgets effectively across both GCP and AWS at scale.
* **Security & Compliance:**
  Expertise in designing and implementing secure cloud architectures, adhering to compliance standards (e.g., SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA if applicable) on both platforms.
* **Migration Experience:**
  Experience leading large-scale migrations to or between cloud platforms is highly desirable.
* **General DevOps & SRE Principles:**
* **Automation:**
  A strong automation mindset with proficiency in scripting languages (e.g., Python, Bash, PowerShell).
* **Monitoring, Logging, and Observability:**
  Experience designing and implementing comprehensive observability solutions for large-scale distributed systems.
* **Site Reliability Engineering (SRE):**
  Understanding and application of SRE principles for availability, reliability, performance, and incident response.
* **DevSecOps:**
  Proven ability to integrate security into all phases of the DevOps lifecycle.

that helps B2C brands increase engagement, conversions, revenue, and retention. Our cutting-edge SaaS products enable personalized engagement across the entire customer journey and build amazing digital experiences for businesses of all sizes.

title: Senior Director - Cloud & AI Platform Engineering

*real solver?*

We're searching for the architects of the audacious & the pioneers of the possible. If you're the type to dismantle assumptions, re-engineer ‘best practices,’ and build solutions that make the future possible NOW, then you're speaking our language.

solving for better.

You own delivery for Cloud & AI Platform Engineering: cloud foundations and migration, data platforms, AI and MLOps foundations, private AI, and the agent runtime that sits on top of them. Every CAPE engagement you lead ends with something running in production, with a named owner, at a cost the client can defend.

Most firms split this work into a cloud team, a data team, an AI team and a FinOps function on the side. Agents ignore those boundaries, so the failures land in the gaps between them. You run CAPE as one system, and you hold it to one bar: evidence from production, not a plan someone approved.

If you have led platform delivery at enterprise scale, you are fluent in how agents actually fail, and you treat utilisation and inference cost as seriously as architecture, this is your seat.

**Your Responsibilities**

*what you will wake up to solve.*

**‣Make the estate agent-ready**

* **Own platform delivery end to end:**
  Lead every CAPE engagement across landing zones, migration, data platforms, MLOps and private or sovereign AI, with running production systems as the finish line rather than approved plans.
* **Build the agent runtime properly:**
  Deliver durable execution, multi-agent orchestration, tool interoperability and agent observability, so client agents survive mid-run failures, act safely across systems, and can be operated by whoever inherits them.
* **Engineer what models can see:**
  Treat retrieval, context engineering and decision instrumentation as first-class deliverables, judged by the business decisions they improve.

**‣Run delivery on evidence, not optimism**

* **Own the delivery economics:**
  Be accountable for billable utilisation, effort efficiency and deviation from SOW across the CAPE portfolio, and make sure we have the people before we promise the work.
* **Deliver cost as an outcome:**
  Make cloud and AI economics part of the engagement: cost allocation, commitment restructuring and lower cost per AI task without a drop in quality, proven by measurement.
* **Report performance honestly:**
  Keep partner-funded work visible separately, so margin and utilisation reflect what the business unit actually earns.

**‣Nothing ships unowned**

* **Launch with an owner:**
  Every platform goes live with someone accountable for running it and the telemetry they need from day one.
* **Escalate early:**
  Surface risks to the client-facing lead before the client has to raise them.
* **Plan the next step at launch:**
  Every go-live comes with a view of what to improve next, so delivery becomes a relationship, not a closing date.

**‣Build the bench by route, not by default**

* **Hold the credential bar:**
  Set and enforce the certification and hands-on standard for cloud, data, ML and FinOps crafts, requalified on real delivery evidence, with leaders held to the same bar as engineers.
* **Choose build or buy per capability:**

* **Turn delivery into differentiation:**
  Maintain working accelerators for landing zones, agent platforms and retrieval, publish on what the team has learned, and represent Searce with our cloud and AI partners.

**Welcome to Searce**

*The ‘process-first’, AI-native modern tech consultancy that's rewriting the rules.*

As an engineering-led consultancy, we are dedicated to relentlessly improving the real business outcomes. Our solvers co-innovate with clients to
**futurify**
operations and make processes smarter, faster & better. We build alongside our clients. Not for the vanity metrics. But for the transformation to embed lasting competitive advantage for our clients.

The result? Modern business reinvention, built on math, tech, and clarity of purpose.

**Functional Skills**

* **Portfolio Judgment:**
  Reads a portfolio of concurrent engagements and knows which one breaks next, and why, before the dashboard turns red.
* **Delivery Economics:**
  Translates technical scope into effort, capacity, cost and margin, and knows which trade-off protects all of them.

**Tech Superpowers**

* **Data Platform Engineering:**

**Experience & Relevance**

ready to futurify?

Future Technologies and Services India is a growing technology and services organization established in 2021, focused on delivering future-ready solutions to clients. The company operates across multiple domains, including software development, web and mobile app development, IT training, digital marketing, financial services, recruitment, and project outsourcing. With a flexible network of in-house professionals and freelancers, Future Technologies and Services India tailors its services to customer requirements and strives for continuous improvement. The organization supports a wide range of technical roles such as PHP, .NET, Angular, Android, iOS, and Java development, offering opportunities to work on diverse projects and technology stacks.

Role Description

The Application Architect / Integration Architect role is an on-site position based in Navi Mumbai, focused on designing and implementing scalable, secure, and high-performance application and integration architectures within the banking/BFSI domain. The role involves translating business requirements into technical solutions, defining architecture standards, evaluating technologies, and ensuring seamless integration across enterprise systems. The architect will assess existing systems, resolve architectural challenges, design new solutions, and collaborate with development, consulting, and operations teams to ensure alignment with business objectives. The role also includes planning architectural improvements, supporting cloud migration strategies, optimizing system performance, assessing technology options based on cost and scalability, and establishing architecture best practices.

Qualifications

* Minimum 12+ years of total professional experience, with at least 5 years of banking/BFSI experience.
* Educational qualification in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline. BE/BTech is preferred; candidates with other undergraduate degrees must have a full-time MCA, MTech, or MSc in a relevant IT/Computer Science field.
* Strong expertise in Application Architecture, Integration Architecture, and Solution Design.
* Ability to design new (Greenfield) architectures and resolve issues in existing (Brownfield) architectures.
* Experience assessing infrastructure, applications, data, cloud environments, and system performance.
* Ability to evaluate and plan migration from monolithic banking systems to cloud-based environments, considering timelines, cost, quality, capacity, and risk.
* Strong understanding of enterprise technologies and the ability to compare platforms such as Azure, AWS, and Google Cloud based on suitability, advantages, limitations, and commercial costs.
* For Application Architects: knowledge of Java/.NET, application design, UI frameworks, Azure Architecture, Java EE, and TOGAF.
* For Integration Architects: expertise in IBM Integration, MuleSoft, APIs, middleware, message queues (MQ), Kafka, and integration design.
* Strong analytical, consulting, communication, and technical decision-making skills.
* Ability to establish architecture standards, document technical solutions, guide project teams, and ensure security, scalability, reliability, and performance.
* **Work Location:**
  Navi Mumbai, Maharashtra.
* **Work Mode:**
  Full-time, work from office, six days a week.
* **Engagement Duration:**
  1 year.
* **Joining:**
  Immediate joiners preferred.

title: TechnoFunctional MES Application Lead
description:
**Job Description:**
TechnoFunctional MES Application Lead
  
  

* Location: PAN India
* Number of Positions: 2
* Experience Required: 8–14 Years
* Work Mode: Hybrid

**Job Summary: (P3/P4)**
We are seeking an experienced TechnoFunctional MES Application Lead to own and drive the endtoend delivery and operational support of Körber PASX solutions on Azure AKS, ensuring timely, and highquality MES services within a regulated manufacturing environment. The role combines strong technical depth and functional understanding of MES processes to coordinate crossfunctional teams, manage integrations and dependencies, proactively resolve issues, and ensure validated, compliant, and reliable MES solutions that meet business, quality, and regulatory requirements.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Own the MES PASX tower (v3.3.x) across programs, ensuring platform stability, scalability and compliance in cloudbased AKS (Azure Kubernetes Services) environments.
* Define and govern MES architecture standards, integration patterns, deployment models and operational best practices for PASX on Azure.
* Ensure alignment of MES tower strategy with manufacturing IT, Digital Manufacturing roadmaps, ISA88/95 standards and enterprise IT governance.
* Act as the single point of accountability for MES PASX delivery, operations, quality and compliance.
* Lead endtoend MES PASX implementations and upgrades, from requirement gathering through configuration, qualification and final delivery.
* Ensure to Coordinate on rollouts and system upgrades for PASX application.
* Own MES Service Delivery Operations, ensuring high availability, performance, and adherence to SLAs.
* Govern 2ndlevel support operations for PASX, Azure, Kubernetes, and MES integrations.
* Lead Incident, Problem, Change and Release Management processes in line with ITIL.
* Proactively identify risks, recurring issues and improvement opportunities to ensure smooth operations.
* Provide technical leadership for PASX deployment and lifecycle management on AKS, including service pack installations and platform upgrades.
* Govern OS, application and platform patching (Windows/Linux) and ensure timely vulnerability remediation.
* Oversee Kubernetes, Linux and databaserelated activities, ensuring performance, resilience and availability of MES environments.
* Collaborate closely with enterprise Infrastructure, Cloud, Security and Network teams.
* Own and govern MES integrations with Level 2, Level 3, and Level 4 systems including SAP ERP, OSI PI, LIMS & Kepware/OPC.
* Ensure robust design, monitoring and support of DCS adapters, services and interfaces.
* Drive troubleshooting for complex crosssystem issues spanning MES, DCS, ERP, and shopfloor automation.
* Establish governance for MES PASX Users & Rights, Control Data & Profiles, Terminals, Printing, and Reporting, Production Units, WMS Master Data, Service & system configurations.
* Ensure data consistency, audit readiness, and alignment with validated system requirements.
* Ensure MES solutions comply with CSV, SDLC, 21 CFR Part 11, cGMP and GAMP requirements.
* Act as the primary interface with vendors such as Körber, Microsoft and system integrators.
* Manage vendor delivery, escalations and roadmap alignment.
* Collaborate closely with business stakeholders, plant teams, QA, infrastructure and enterprise IT leadership.
* Provide technical and functional leadership to MES engineers and support teams.
* Mentor team members on PASX functionality, cloud/K8s concepts, validation and integrations.
* Drive proactive collaboration, knowledge sharing, and operational excellence within the MES tower.
* Identify opportunities for automation, standardization and performance optimization within MES operations.

title: Infrastructure Engineer II – Data Platforms
description:
**Company Overview**
We exist to make food the world loves. But we do more than that. Our company is a place that prioritizes being a force for good, a place to expand learning, explore new perspectives and reimagine new possibilities, every day. We look for people who want to bring their best — bold thinkers with big hearts who challenge one another and grow together. Because becoming the undisputed leader in food means surrounding ourselves with people who are hungry for what’s next.
  
  
**Overview**
Are you a database expert who thrives in a fast-paced, multi-platform environment? As a Senior Infrastructure Engineer on our Digital & Technology team, you will lead the migration and modernization of enterprise Microsoft SQL Server databases to the public cloud. You will administer mission-critical SQL Server 2019 and 2022 platforms in a 24/7 environment, focusing on Availability Groups, Distributed Availability Groups, PowerShell automation, and terraform. This is your opportunity to shape cloud database engineering at a Fortune 500 company.
  
  
**Key Accountabilities**

* Lead Microsoft SQL Server migration and modernization to the public cloud.
* Migrate SQL Server workloads to GCP or other public cloud platforms.
* Own migration processes, documentation, automation, and tooling.
* Administer mission-critical SQL Server 2019 and 2022 platforms in a 24/7 environment.
* Implement and support SQL Server Availability Groups.
* Implement and support Distributed Availability Groups.
* Perform database tuning, capacity planning, backup and recovery, patching, and upgrades.
* Use PowerShell to automate provisioning, monitoring, and support processes.
* Use Terraform to provision and manage database infrastructure in cloud environments.
* Meet cloud security standards and reduce operational and security risk.
* Collaborate with application stakeholders to resolve tickets.
* Resolve failures and critical alerts within an Agile framework.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Experience: 5+ years administering, designing, modernizing, or migrating enterprise SQL Server databases.
* Core Technical Skills: SQL Server 2019 and 2022; Availability Groups; Distributed Availability Groups; PowerShell; and terraform.
* High Availability and Recovery: Experience with HA, DR, backup and recovery, tuning, and production support.
* Cloud Experience: Experience with cloud adoption, security, governance, and integration.
* Automation and DevOps: Experience automating provisioning, support, monitoring, and lifecycle operations with PowerShell and Terraform.
* Operating Systems: Strong Windows Server and Windows clustering experience; Linux is beneficial.
* Engineering Practices: Working knowledge of DevOps and Agile practices and proofs of concept.
* Service Orientation: Experience designing user-centric database services, including self-service provisioning.
* Soft Skills: Excellent communication and collaboration skills; flexible, reliable, self-starting, and customer focused.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Cloud Database Experience: Experience operating SQL Server workloads on GCP, Azure, AWS, or other public clouds.
* Automation Tooling: Ansible, GitHub, or similar tooling; Python scripting.
* Infrastructure Engineering: CI/CD practices and automated database provisioning workflows.
* Additional Experience: Agile methods, Linux administration, and PostgreSQL, MySQL, or MongoDB.

**ELIGIBILITY**
Applicants must meet minimum age qualifications in the country in which the job is located.

title: Security Customer Engineer, Google Cloud

title: Senior Engineer
description:
We are hiring Senior / Lead Engineers to design, build, and scale robust, production-grade data and platform systems for a product portfolio within Blenheim. This is a hands-on engineering role where you will own complex problem areas end-to-end, influence system architecture, mentor engineers, and deliver scalable solutions in a fast-growing, product-led environment.
  
  
If you enjoy working with ambiguity, building platforms from the ground up, and shipping real business impact, we’d love to hear from you.
  
  
**About Blenheim Chalcot:**
Blenheim Chalcot India is part of Blenheim Chalcot, a global venture builder headquartered in London. With over 26 years of innovation, we've been at the forefront of creating some of the most groundbreaking GenAI-enabled companies. Our ventures lead the charge in digital disruption across a spectrum of industries, from FinTech to EdTech, GovTech to Media, and beyond. Our global presence spans the US, Europe, and Southeast Asia, with a portfolio that employs over 3,000 individuals, manages assets exceeding £1.8 billion, and boasts total portfolio sales of over £500 million.
  
  
**The Role:**
As a Senior / Lead Engineer, you will play a key role in designing and delivering scalable systems across core platforms. You will collaborate closely with Product, Data, and Engineering teams in Mumbai and London, helping shape technical direction while remaining hands-on.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**
Successful candidates will take a leading role within our Engineering Centre of Excellence in Mumbai, with day to day responsibilities which will include.
  
  

* Lead and mentor a team of engineers, fostering a culture of collaboration and continuous improvement.
* Oversee the planning and execution of projects, ensuring alignment with business objectives and timelines.
* Provide technical guidance and expertise to the team, promoting best practices in engineering.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand requirements and deliver effective solutions.
* Implement and maintain ELT (Extract, Load, Transform) processes using scalable pipelines and data architecture.
* Ensure data integrity and quality across various data sources.
* Support data-driven decision-making by providing clean, reliable, and timely data.
* Design, develop, and maintain the data models used by ML Engineers, Data Analysts and Data Scientists to access data.
* Conduct exploratory data analysis to uncover patterns and trends.
* Identify opportunities for process improvement and drive continuous improvement in operations.
* Stay updated on industry trends, technologies, and best practices in engineering.

**About You:**
We are seeking to onboard candidates with a track record of leading complex delivery, demonstrating technical depth and pragmatic leadership. You’re hands‑on when it matters, coach others effectively, and make clear design trade‑offs that improve customer and business outcomes. You communicate crisply, collaborate across functions, and keep teams focused on the few things that move the needle.
  
  
**The Ideal Candidate:**

* Professional experience in full-stack software engineering with evidence of architecting and delivering production systems at scale.
* Proven experience mentoring and developing engineers and raising code quality standards.
* Strong proficiency in one or more programming languages commonly used in engineering, such as Python or Java.
* Extensive experience with database systems, including SQL and NoSQL databases.
* In-depth knowledge of cloud data platforms like AWS or Azure (e.g., S3, Redshift, Glue, Data Factory, Azure Synapse, etc.).
* Experience with CI/CD practices for data solutions.
* Experience leveraging AI tools (GitHub Copilot, Claude etc) and building AI-enabled features (e.g., LLMs, automation workflows, prompt engineering, AI-assisted development) to enhance product capabilities and engineering productivity.
* Proven ability to take ownership over outputs and drive complex data projects to completion.
* Highly adaptable and comfortable working in ambiguous, problem-solving environments.
* Strong evidence of teamwork and successful cross-functional delivery; including particularly with customers, Product, Marketing, and Sales.
* Excellent communication, leadership, and collaboration skills.

Behaviours that we look for
  
  

* Rigorous problem-solving and systems thinking. Breaks down complex problems, evaluates multiple approaches, and designs scalable, maintainable architectures.
* Clean, performant, and secure code. Chooses suitable data structures, writes readable & defensive code, and bakes in performance and security from the start.
* Test-first and observable engineering. Designs for testability, automates meaningful unit/integration tests, and implements robust logging, metrics, and monitoring.
* Production and operations excellence. Understands CI/CD, infrastructure and cost drivers, engineers for reliable development, resilience, and fast recovery.
* Data-driven, outcome-focused decisions. Validates ideas with data, plans for schema evaluation, and aligns features with real user impact.

Process - We have a rigorous, but streamlined recruitment process, which respects the time of candidates and portfolio companies alike. This process starts with a 15-minute call with our Talent Acquisition team and a member of the Engineering Centre of Excellence, followed by further interviews with the Engineering Centre of Excellence team.
  
  
Please note that our roles are primarily office based, with modern and well-connected office locations in both Andheri East and Navi Mumbai.

title: Senior Platform Engineer
description:
Your Team Responsibilities
  
  
The DevOps Platform Engineering team builds and runs the tooling, platforms and workflows that every engineering team at MSCI uses to deliver software. We operate as a software engineering team whose customers are other engineers — we build internal products, APIs, automation and integrations, and we run them as products with roadmaps, users and service commitments.
  
  
We own and maintain several Developer tools in MSCI's developer toolchain end to end. That covers the tools engineers work in every day, including GitHub Enterprise, Azure DevOps, SonarQube and Cursor, as well as the platforms we build and run ourselves such as our Backstage-based internal developer portal. Ownership here means we select, integrate, secure, operate and continuously improve these services, and we are accountable for their availability,and adoption across the firm.
  
  
Alongside the tools, we enable standardisation across the software development lifecycle. We define the golden paths, reusable CI/CD workflows, platform abstractions, engineering standards and governance models that product and engineering teams adopt so they can move quickly without re-solving the same problems.
  
  
As part of the MSCI Core DevOps Engineering team, you will help shape where software delivery and developer enablement go next across the organisation.
  
  
**What The Team Owns**

* Developer tooling: GitHub Enterprise, Azure DevOps, SonarQube, Docker, Cursor
* Internal developer platforms: Backstage-based developer portal and our in-house developer productivity platform
* CI/CD platforms, reusable pipelines and release automation
* SDLC standards, golden paths and governance models
* Self-service capabilities, internal APIs and integrations that remove manual toil from engineering teams
* Developer experience measurement, adoption and the services we provide to engineering teams across MSCI

Your Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Build and maintain reusable CI/CD frameworks, GitHub Actions workflows, templates, and platform abstractions that make the golden paths the fastest way to ship software at MSCI — simple enough to adopt quickly, flexible enough for diverse engineering use cases.
* Develop and support internal platform capabilities, APIs, automation services, and integrations across the developer toolchain, including GitHub Enterprise, Azure DevOps, SonarQube, Cursor, Backstage, and our in-house developer productivity platform.
* Run the developer tooling estate as a product: monitor health and usage, resolve issues, manage upgrades and configuration, and improve the reliability of services engineers depend on daily.
* Apply proactive problem solving to developer pain points — find friction in engineering workflows before it is escalated, trace issues to root cause, and deliver durable fixes rather than workarounds.
* Bring intellectual curiosity and a critical thinking mindset to platform decisions: evaluate new tools, patterns, and approaches on their merits, and make evidence-based recommendations that raise the quality of what we deliver to our developers.

title: Senior Engineer, Digital Collaboration & Messaging (SharePoint)
description:
**Senior Enterprise Systems Engineer (SharePoint)**
The Senior Enterprise Systems Engineer (SharePoint) is a senior technical practitioner responsible specifically for the engineering, administration, governance, reliability, migration, and continuous improvement of the firm’s enterprise SharePoint Online environment. This role serves as the technical subject matter expert for SharePoint within the Messaging and Productivity Platforms function. This is a Hybrid role and works in 2pm-11pm IST shift.
  
  
**Key Job Responsibilities Include**
The engineer will own the technical administration and engineering of SharePoint Online and play a significant role in SharePoint migrations, tenant consolidations, mergers and acquisitions, content remediation, lifecycle management, governance, and automation.
  
  
**SharePoint Online Administration & Engineering**

* Engineer, administer, and continuously improve the enterprise SharePoint Online environment.
* Maintain tenant-level SharePoint configurations and administrative controls.
* Establish and maintain standards for site architecture, provisioning, permissions, ownership, sharing, and lifecycle management.
* Manage and monitor SharePoint storage, site collections, access, configuration, and platform health.
* Develop scalable technical solutions for SharePoint administration and management.
* Evaluate SharePoint Online product changes and assess their potential impact on the enterprise environment.
* Plan, test, and implement SharePoint platform changes in a controlled and supportable manner.
* Identify and remediate stale, abandoned, redundant, orphaned, or improperly configured SharePoint sites.
* Develop automation using PowerShell, PnP PowerShell, Microsoft Graph, APIs, and other appropriate technologies.
* Reduce manual SharePoint administration through repeatable engineering and automation.

**SharePoint Migration Engineering;**

* Plan and execute enterprise SharePoint Online migrations.
* Support SharePoint migrations associated with mergers, acquisitions, divestitures, tenant consolidations, and organizational transformation.
* Perform technical discovery and assessment of source SharePoint environments.
* Analyze sites, content, permissions, metadata, links, customizations, dependencies, and other migration considerations.
* Determine migration readiness and identify technical risks, remediation requirements, and dependencies.
* Develop migration strategies, technical migration plans, sequencing, migration waves, validation procedures, and rollback approaches.
* Configure and operate enterprise SharePoint migration technologies.
* Develop scripts and automation to improve migration discovery, preparation, execution, validation, and reporting.
* Troubleshoot complex migration failures and develop appropriate remediation strategies.
* Perform pre- and post-migration validation of content, permissions, metadata, links, access, and functionality.
* Identify obsolete, redundant, unsupported, or unnecessary content and determine appropriate remediation rather than automatically carrying technical debt into the destination environment.
* Develop repeatable migration processes and standards that can be reused for future migration initiatives.
* Transition migrated environments into established SharePoint governance and lifecycle-management processes.

**SharePoint Governance & Lifecycle Management**

* Establish and maintain enterprise SharePoint governance standards.
* Define and maintain standards for site provisioning, ownership, permissions, external sharing, and lifecycle.
* Establish processes for identifying and managing inactive, abandoned, and orphaned sites.
* Support site expiration, archival, retention, and decommissioning processes.
* Maintain appropriate controls for external and guest sharing.
* Partner with Information Security on SharePoint security and data-protection requirements.
* Partner with Identity & Access Management on SharePoint authentication, access, guest identity, and related access-management requirements.
* Improve visibility into SharePoint ownership, usage, storage, health, and lifecycle.
* Identify opportunities to reduce SharePoint technical debt and platform sprawl.

**Advanced SharePoint Troubleshooting**

* Serve as an advanced engineering escalation point for complex SharePoint Online issues.
* Troubleshoot complex permissions, authentication, access, sharing, configuration, content, and migration problems.
* Investigate issues that cannot be effectively resolved through established frontline or second-level support processes.
* Perform root-cause analysis and implement permanent engineering solutions where possible.
* Identify patterns across escalated incidents that indicate broader platform or governance problems.
* Engage Microsoft and SharePoint technology vendors when vendor-level escalation is required.
* Document solutions and transfer repeatable troubleshooting knowledge to appropriate support teams.

**Required Experience & Qualifications**

* 5+ years of experience administering and engineering enterprise SharePoint environments.
* Deep hands-on experience with SharePoint Online in a medium-to-large enterprise environment.
* Strong experience with enterprise SharePoint administration, configuration, governance, and lifecycle management.
* Demonstrated experience planning and executing large-scale SharePoint migrations.
* Experience with SharePoint Online tenant-to-tenant migrations or similar complex enterprise migration initiatives.
* Strong understanding of SharePoint architecture, sites, permissions, sharing, metadata, storage, and content structures.
* Experience performing technical discovery and migration-readiness assessments.
* Experience identifying migration dependencies, risks, technical debt, and remediation requirements.
* Experience validating content, permissions, metadata, links, access, and functionality following migrations.
* Strong PowerShell and PnP PowerShell scripting and automation skills.
* Experience using Microsoft Graph, APIs, or other automation technologies for SharePoint administration.
* Strong understanding of SharePoint security, permissions, guest access, and external sharing.
* Experience troubleshooting complex SharePoint Online platform and migration issues.
* Experience performing root-cause analysis and resolving complex technical problems.
* Experience working with enterprise security, compliance, retention, and data-governance requirements.
* Experience working within enterprise Incident, Problem, and Change Management processes.
* Strong technical documentation and communication skills.
* Ability to independently drive complex technical work across multiple technical and business teams.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with enterprise SharePoint migration platforms such as ShareGate or equivalent technologies.
* Experience supporting mergers, acquisitions, divestitures, or tenant consolidations involving SharePoint.
* Experience migrating SharePoint Server or other legacy SharePoint environments to SharePoint Online.
* Experience with Microsoft Purview capabilities relevant to SharePoint, including retention, information protection, and eDiscovery.
* Experience with Microsoft Entra ID, Conditional Access, guest access, and external identity capabilities as they relate to SharePoint.
* Experience with SharePoint site lifecycle automation and enterprise governance tooling.
* Experience with Microsoft Graph and API-based SharePoint automation.
* Relevant Microsoft 365 or SharePoint certifications.

description:
**About This Role**
**About Global Fixed Income Team**
BlackRock’s active fixed income portfolio strategies stretch across a range of investment styles and segments of the fixed income universe. The breadth and depth of our platform puts us in a strong position to potentially deliver attractive returns in various market environments. With a focus on alpha generation and risk management, the team uses a top-down view from lead portfolio managers and bottom-up expertise from our sector specialists
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for a Software Testing Analyst to help deliver reliable web applications, APIs, data integrations, and AI-powered features. You will work closely with developers, business analysts, and stakeholders to define quality criteria, identify risks early, and assess whether features are ready for release.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Review requirements and define acceptance criteria, test plans, and regression scenarios.
* Assess AI-generated responses for relevance, factual support, consistency, and correct use of supporting sources.
* Validate data across application screens, APIs, databases, and generated outputs.
* Cover edge cases and failure scenarios, including invalid inputs, timeouts, interrupted requests, and access restrictions.
* Own defects from discovery through resolution: investigate issues, communicate their impact, and verify fixes.
* Build and maintain automated checks, reusable test data, and quality documentation.
* Communicate quality risks and provide clear recommendations on release readiness.

**Must know**

* Test-case design, manual testing, regression testing, and defect management.
* Programming in Python, Java, or a similar language, with the ability to write validation scripts.
* API testing, including HTTP, JSON, and response validation.
* SQL for data validation and troubleshooting.
* Test automation using a framework such as pytest, Selenium, or Playwright.
* SDLC, STLC, Git, and collaborative delivery practices.
* Structured problem-solving and clear communication.

**Good to know**

* Quality evaluation for AI applications, including prompt variations, unsupported claims, source grounding, and response quality.
* Large language model and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) concepts.
* CI/CD pipelines, application logs, and browser developer tools.
* Accessibility, performance, and security testing.

Relevant experience may come from professional work, internships, or substantial projects. We value someone who takes initiative and can drive quality from requirements through release.
  
  
**Education & Qualifications**

* 1-3 years of relevant work experience

**Problem-Solving**

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including root-cause analysis.
* Ability to gather requirements and translate business needs into technical solutions.
* Clear communication with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

**Our Benefits**
To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.
  
  
**Our hybrid work model**
BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.
  
  
**Guidance on AI use for candidates**
At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided
**guidance**
on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.
  
  
**About BlackRock**
At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.
  
  
This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.
  
  
To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok.
  
  
BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, disability, family status, gender identity, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation and other protected attributes at law.

As an increasing number of enterprises move their critical systems to the cloud, AWS India is in need of highly efficient technical consulting talent to help our largest and strategically important customers navigate the operational challenges and complexities of AWS Cloud. Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. Work/Life Balance
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

The Senior Enterprise Systems Engineer (Mac) is a senior technical practitioner responsible for the engineering, administration, security, reliability, and continuous improvement of the firm’s enterprise macOS environment. The engineer will serve as a subject matter expert for macOS and Apple endpoint technologies, with primary responsibility for JAMF Pro and related capabilities supporting the management, configuration, security, application delivery, and lifecycle of enterprise Mac devices. This is a Hybrid role and works in 2pm-11pm IST shift.
  
  
**Key Job Responsibilities Include**
This is a hands-on engineering position that combines workplace platform engineering with advanced technical troubleshooting. The successful candidate will engineer scalable Mac-management solutions, automate repeatable activities, improve platform capabilities, and investigate complex escalations that cannot be effectively resolved by the service desk or second-level support.
  
  

* Engineer, administer, and continuously improve the firm’s enterprise macOS management environment using JAMF Pro and related Apple technologies.
* Design and maintain macOS configuration profiles, policies, security controls, restrictions, scripts, and device-management standards.
* Engineer and maintain automated Mac enrollment, provisioning, configuration, and lifecycle-management capabilities.
* Develop, package, test, deploy, and maintain enterprise applications for macOS.
* Develop and maintain scripts and automation to improve Mac administration, application delivery, remediation, reporting, and operational efficiency.
* Serve as an advanced engineering escalation point for complex macOS, application, configuration, enrollment, authentication, and device-management issues.
* Investigate escalations from the service desk, second-level support teams, and managed service providers that require advanced Mac engineering expertise.
* Perform root-cause analysis of recurring issues and implement permanent engineering solutions rather than relying on repeated manual remediation.
* Troubleshoot complex application installation, compatibility, configuration, upgrade, and deployment failures.
* Support macOS operating system upgrades, patching, security updates, and lifecycle activities.
* Evaluate new macOS releases and Apple platform changes and assess potential enterprise impact.
* Plan, test, and implement macOS platform upgrades and new capabilities in a controlled and supportable manner.
* Monitor Mac fleet health, compliance, configuration, application deployment, and other indicators of platform reliability.
* Partner with Information Security on endpoint security requirements, vulnerability remediation, configuration standards, and compliance activities.
* Partner with Identity & Access Management teams on authentication, SSO, device registration, Conditional Access, certificates, and related identity capabilities.
* Support integrations between JAMF, Microsoft technologies, security platforms, identity systems, and other enterprise services.
* Participate in technical design reviews, change management, problem management, and major incident resolution when Mac platform expertise is required.
* Develop and maintain technical documentation, engineering standards, troubleshooting procedures, runbooks, and knowledge articles.
* Transfer knowledge to service desk, second-level support, and managed service providers so repeatable issues can be resolved at the appropriate support level.
* Identify opportunities to reduce Mac technical debt, eliminate manual processes, increase automation, and improve the employee technology experience.

**Advanced Technical Escalation Responsibilities**

* Troubleshoot complex macOS and device-management issues that cannot be effectively resolved by frontline or second-level support.
* Investigate difficult application failures, enrollment problems, authentication issues, configuration problems, performance issues, and device-management failures.
* Identify patterns across escalated incidents and determine whether the underlying cause requires an engineering or platform-level correction.

title: Senior SRE ( DevOps)
description:
**about searce**

Searce is an AI outcome engineering company and a modern technology consultancy that helps enterprises futurify their business with AI, cloud and data. Founded in 2004, we are 1,300+ Searcians across 12 countries, with deep business process expertise, a Google Cloud Global MSP status and compliance credentials including PCI DSS and ISO 27001. We solve with our proprietary evlos™ problem-solving methodology: no bureaucratic fluff, working prototypes fast, and production scale that holds.

**about ATRE**

ATRE is Searce's AI Trust & Resilience Engineering practice: the managed-service team that keeps customers' cloud and AI estates secure, reliable and resilient 24x7. We are building it AI-first. Every engineer is expected to use AI tools and AIOps to raise efficiency, cut toil and shorten recovery time.

**role overview**

As a Senior Engineer you are the L3 backbone of the ATRE managed-service team. You resolve the complex incidents that L1/L2 cannot, find the root cause, and then automate the fix. You use AI tools and AIOps to work faster than manual operations allow, and you keep customer cloud and AI workloads secure and reliable.

**what you'll do**

* **L3 ownership:**
  Handle escalated Sev-1/Sev-2 incidents, drive them to resolution and own the follow-up.
* **Root cause analysis:**
  Run blameless post-incident reviews and implement long-term fixes that prevent recurrence.
* **AI-led efficiency:**
  Apply AI tools and AIOps to triage, correlate alerts, accelerate RCA and automate repeat work.
* **Automation:**
  Build reusable automation and runbooks in Terraform, Python or Bash to remove toil.
* **Platform operations:**
  Operate and secure Kubernetes (GKE) and cloud infrastructure, including patching, upgrades and DR drills.
* **Observability:**
  Maintain monitoring, alerting, SLIs and SLOs so issues surface before customers feel them.
* **Security hygiene:**
  Apply IAM, secrets management, network policy and vulnerability remediation across customer environments.
* **Knowledge sharing:**
  Document solutions and help L1/L2 engineers grow.

**what you bring**

* **Delivery experience:**
  Hands-on production experience in SRE, DevOps or cloud operations, including real L3 incident handling.
* **Technical depth:**
  Strong in at least one hyperscaler (GCP preferred), Kubernetes and Infrastructure as Code.
* **Observability:**
  Hands-on with Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, ELK or similar.
* **Scripting:**
  Python or Bash for systems automation.
* **AI-led efficiency:**
  Practical experience using AI tools to improve SRE efficiency (AI-assisted runbooks, incident triage, RCA, automation) and/or AIOps platforms (e.g., BigPanda, Moogsoft, Dynatrace, Datadog), with measurable results such as lower MTTR, less toil or reduced alert noise.
* **Work mode:**
  Comfortable working from the office.

**good to have**

* Cloud certifications (e.g., Google Professional Cloud DevOps Engineer, AWS DevOps Engineer, Azure AZ-104/AZ-400)
* CKA / CKS
* Exposure to AI/LLM workload security
* On-call and 24x7 managed service experience

**why searce**

* **Solver mindset:**
  We hire solvers, not task-takers. You will be trusted to own problems end to end.
* **Not a CAVEr, say no to HiPPO:**
  We are not Citizens Against Virtually Everything, and the best idea wins over the highest-paid person's opinion.
* **AI-native practice:**
  ATRE is built around AI tools and AIOps from day one, so you build the future of managed services rather than inherit the past.
* **Learning and growth:**
  Partner-led certifications and exposure to Google Cloud, AWS, Databricks and Anthropic Claude ecosystems.
* **Culture:**
  HAPPIER values (humble, adaptable, positive, passionate, innovative, excellence, responsible).

  **HTTPS**
  (REST/SOAP APIs) and
  **SFTP**
  file transfers.

  Basic understanding of CI/CD concepts, deployment workflows, and release cycles.

title: Want to Build the Technology that could Reinvent 3PL & E-COMMERCE / Q-COMMERCE Supply Chains?
description:
**Senior Software Engineering:**

**E-Commerce Marketplaces & AI Supply chain & Logistics Tech Product Build**

**Goldfishh Supply Chain Technologies Pvt. Ltd. - www.goldfishh.com**

We’re looking for a senior technology builder who doesn’t just want to maintain software — but wants to
**architect and build technology products from the ground up.**

Goldfishh operates at the intersection of
**Supply Chain, Warehousing, 3PL, E-Commerce and Marketplace Commerce**
. As we scale our physical and digital ecosystem, we are embarking on an ambitious technology journey to build
**AI-powered platforms that can fundamentally change how businesses manage warehousing, fulfilment, logistics and marketplace commerce.**

We are looking for an experienced
**Software Engineering / Product Technology leader**
who wants to be part of this journey from an early stage.

**What You Will Build**

You will play a key role in architecting and developing technology platforms across:

•
**N2N / Multi-Sided Digital Marketplaces**
connecting businesses, service providers, infrastructure and supply-chain capacity.

•
**E-Commerce & Marketplace Technology**
integrating marketplaces, D2C platforms, OMS, WMS, inventory, fulfilment, advertising, pricing and revenue optimisation.

•
**Warehousing & 3PL Technology**
for distributed warehouse networks, fulfilment operations, inventory visibility and supply-chain orchestration.

•
**AI-Native Products & Agents**
using Generative AI, LLMs, machine learning, intelligent automation and agentic workflows.

•
**Data & Decision Intelligence**
capable of converting large volumes of operational, commercial and marketplace data into actionable recommendations.

•
**APIs & Integrations**
connecting ERP, WMS, OMS, TMS, marketplaces, e-commerce platforms, logistics partners and enterprise systems.

The objective is not simply to digitise existing processes.

**We want to rethink them.**

**Who We Are Looking For**

You should ideally have:

•
**10–15+ years of software engineering / technology product development experience.**

• BE / BTech or equivalent engineering degree, preferably from a
**premier engineering institution**
.

• Strong hands-on experience architecting and building
**scalable technology products**
, preferably within technology startups or high-growth product companies.

• Proven experience with
**N2N / B2B / B2C marketplaces, e-commerce platforms or multi-sided digital ecosystems**
.

• Strong understanding of modern
**cloud-native architecture, APIs, microservices, databases and scalable distributed systems**
.

• Practical experience designing or building products using
**Generative AI, LLMs, AI Agents, RAG, machine learning or AI-driven automation**
.

• Ability to think simultaneously as a
**Product Architect, Software Engineer and Technology Innovator**
.

• Experience taking products from
**concept → architecture → MVP → production → scale**
.

Most importantly, you should still enjoy
**building**
.

We are not looking for someone whose role has become entirely managerial. We want a senior technologist who can define architecture, make critical engineering decisions, work with developers and remain close to the product and the code.

**Technology Stack & AI-Native Architecture**

We intend to build Goldfishh’s technology platform as a
**cloud-native, API-first, modular and AI-native architecture designed for an Agentic AI future**

. The preferred technology ecosystem will include
**Python and TypeScript/Node.js**

, modern web frameworks such as
**React/Next.js**

,
**PostgreSQL and NoSQL/vector databases**

, containerised microservices using
**Docker/Kubernetes**

, and scalable cloud infrastructure on
**AWS/Azure/GCP**

. The AI layer will leverage
**LLMs, multimodal models, RAG, embeddings, vector search, knowledge graphs, MCP, tool/function calling and multi-agent orchestration frameworks**

, with the flexibility to work across leading foundation models and open-source models rather than becoming dependent on a single AI provider. The architecture should enable autonomous AI Agents to securely interact with our
**futuristic N2N Marketplace, WMS, OMS, TMS, ERP, e-commerce, logistics and external partner systems through APIs and event-driven workflows**

. We are looking for an engineer who can help us make the right technology choices in discussion with the core team while designing an architecture capable of evolving towards
**AI Agents that can reason, plan, execute, collaborate and automate increasingly complex supply-chain and commerce workflows.**

**Why Goldfishh?**

Goldfishh is 6 year old Tech stratup building at the intersection of two enormous ecosystems:

**Physical Supply Chains × Digital Commerce.**
Our operating businesses across warehousing, 3PL, logistics and e-commerce give us something particularly valuable for technology innovation:
**Real customers. Real warehouses. Real inventory. Real transactions. Real operational problems to solve.**

Our ambition is to convert that operating experience into
**disruptive, scalable technology products for the supply-chain and commerce ecosystem.**

**Our founding team comprises BITS Pilani / IIT alumni, bringing deep domain expertise, entrepreneurial experience and strong technology-product DNA. We are now preparing for our first institutional VC fundraise to accelerate the next phase of growth.**
We deliberately stayed away from VC funding in our formative years—choosing to first build the business, prove the model, acquire customers and generate revenues. Now, we believe the time is right to scale with external capital.

This is an opportunity for someone who wants to look back a few years from now and say:
